tei:div.tei:p: par rdor sems gsang lam dra med shel bum phyag 'tshal lta ba'i klong bshagasaḥrī tra'i sme bshags rgyu lam 'bras bu'e bshags pa rdzas bskang tshogs bskus gsol khaḥmachod phreng me mchod gnas 1511rus sbyangs tshwa sgrub rma lam bar do 'cha kha bar do chos nyid bar do srid pa bar do bar do' drug khrid bsam gtan bar doḥ'od gsal be bumaḥ'agro drug shan 'byed gnas spar shan 'byed man ngag sgom khrid nyi ma mkha' khyab yig brgya'i don khrid mdzub mo zla dpe skor 'di de rnams yod snyi

sgoX bla ma'i rnal 'byer grub gnyes gter mardzad bzhugs ༷ na moguruyaḥ zaXlnga/༷ khyed shes dad pa drags po yis na mo gu rtsa stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa ye sgo gyi klong nasaḥ ye shes gzigs pa nub med skyabs mgon gyi bla maḥ mtsho byung rgyal ba'i rnam rol rtsa gsum gyi sprin phung: mos ldan bdag gi mdun mkhar mngon sum ltar gsal gdabaḥ e ma hoḥ dgongs brda' snyan brgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs kyi drod ldan rtsa gsum chos skyong kun dngos o rgyan gyi slob dponaX snyigs 'gro'i gdul bya skyong mdzad nus ldan gling mkhyen no blo bral rang bzhag lta ba ka dag tu grol nasaX tshe gcig dpal rir 'tshogs pa'i byin rlabs rang zhu'oḥ ma ma hā gu ru srur+ya marnya bha tra sarba sirnyi pha la hūṃ ci nus bzlas mthar rje btsun bla ma'i byin rlabs dran mo ru byung ste bdag rgyud sgo gsum mtshan ma bag chags kun dag nas ༷ thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pa khyab brdal gyi ngang nasaḥ mnyam bzhag rjes thob kun tu rnal 'byor la 'bad khuraX rlung sems 'khrul ba'i 'ching thag rang zhig la thal nasaX chos sku'i dgongs pa rtogs pa'i byin

rlabs de 'pho mdzodaḥ zhes pa'ang rang slob brtan skyong nas bkra shas lha regs bcas nas nan bskul ngor nus ldan pas smras pa masgo leḥ bkra shis dge'o dge'oḥ—13 dran rdzogs pho po'i gsal 'debs ni āḥ snang ba mngon dga'i zhing khams laḥ srid pa thugs mchog rdo rje'i dal ༷ rang rig bla ma bcom ldan 'dasaḥ ye shes thugs kyi 'dzadar 81ra bltaḥ skyed badz+ra sa tā hūṃ dgongs pa'i nga gnas ci rigs brjod nyams chagasabyang la rtogs pa rgyas sa ma phu rgya rgya rgyaḥ zhes pa 'di'ang bla ma 'od chos nas bskul ngor nus ldan pas bras pa maṅga lam sngags kyas mchod ca nga hrīḥ mi rtog ye shes bcom ldan 'dasaḥ bde ga gas thugs kyi rdo rje che dri bral shel dkar bkrag brgya gya'i 'khyudaX dpal ldan bla ma khyed la bstodaX zhes 'od chos nas bskul ngor nus ldan pa sa soḥ sarba ma le

shārwa dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol ba lasaḥ dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la gsol 'debs grub gnyis gter stsol bzhugs soḥ——1 —bye mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra yeḥ shargargabardeg dra med ye shes bcom ldan 'das rang byung sa sa rgyas nyid la 'dud ngo bo mngon gyur ye sa med pas gsol ba 'di ltar 'debs par bya na mo badz+ra sa twa yaḥ dri med dung mdog mtshan dpe'i lang tsho canaḥ ye shes thugs kyi rdo rjer byang chub paḥ chos kyi dbang phyug lag na rdo rje laḥ gsol ba 'debs so rtog sgrib sbyangs ba dngaḥ byin gyis rlobs shigs sku gsum mngon gyur shogaḥ phyag g.yas rig stong gser gyi rdo rje dngaḥ g.yon pas snang stong dngul dkar dril bu brten 'khor 'das mnyam sbyor phyag rgya'i dkyil 'khor laḥ gsol ba 'debs so gzung 'dzin mtshan ma grol0 byin gyis rlobs shig sku gsum mngon gyur shog: mkhyen nus brtse ba'i 'dzum zhal 'od stong 'khyugaḥ ye shes 'od sku gdos po'i spros pa bralaḥ srid zhi mi gnas mnyam nyid skyil krung bzhugasaḥ gsol ba 'debs so khams gsum 'od skur sgolaX byin gyis

rlobs shig sku gsum mngon gyur shog: ye shes sgyu 'phrul gtso dang 'khor gyi tshul snang srid zung 'jug shes rab phyag rgya che don la gnyis med ngo bo nyid du rolaḥ gsol ba 'debs so snang srid chos skur sad byin gyis rlabs shig sgyu lus 'od skur grol don gnyis mthar phyin gdod ma'i grol sa ru ka dag dang po'i sangs rgyas mngon gyur 31ga de ltar gsol btab byan rlabs 'jug dgongs rgyud dri med ye shes 'char gzung 'dzin mtshan ma chos skur grol don gnyis lhun grub the tshom medaḥ sa ma shāḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thim snyiḥ zhesapa 'di'ang chos 'di la las dbang 'dzom pa ma ṇi'i ming can gyis bkra shisalha reg rin chen gnyisapa'i skyes bcas bskul ngor kho bo bdud 'jom nus ldan rtsal gyis 'od gsal sgyu ma'i brda mdzod lasadag bar phab pa'i yi ge pa ni marnya sta tra ma chas bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba maṅga le

jorta dag snang sgyu 'phrul rngal ba las sgrub pa'i rkyen bzlog sngon 'arga gter rgya bum pa dz+ran las lhun 'grub bzhugs soḥ——rji na ( de ru padh+wa ka ra ye 'i2skorta1 dkar dmar skyems phud gtor dzos bkram bsangs sbyangs spel la byin gyas rlabs rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis dkar nag pho nya brngan pa niḥ dza hūṃ zhes brjod pho nya bkugs de nas snyan pa 'i glu dbyangs kyisaḥ/ hrī chos nyid stong pa'i gsang sgog can phyi nang gsang sprul mchog sde brgyadaX bka' 'khor sprul pa dpung dang bcasaḥ sngon gyi tha tshig la dgongs nas sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ gtum rngams gdug pa'i sems bral zhing zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i mdangs bstan nas dkar dmar gtor skyems dgyes bzhes teḥ sgrub pa po yi 'gal rkyen bzlogaḥ rnam bzhi'i las kyi sdong grogs mdzodaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang sems can kun gyi phan bde spelaḥ nag phyogs gdug pa'i sma phab steḥ rdzogs ldan gsar tshes snang ba yisaX 'dzam gling kun khyab phrin las mdzod dam la ma 'da' sa ma yāḥ zhes brjod gtor skyems gtsang

sar gshegs gang bcol phrin la thogs med 'grubaḥ sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥsnyiḥ zhes pa 'ad 'ang zab chos 'di la las dbang gi 'phro 'dzoms pa pa ṇa'i ming gas bskul ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis ye shes sgyu ma'i gsang brda dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni saman+ta bha tra ma ḍi so0 sarba maṅga leḥ
—— dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol ba lasaḥdapal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i zab sgrub ye shes nyi ma bzhugs soḥ

shā1) na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye 21 bde chen thugs kyi rdo rje che dri med ye shes gzigs pa can sku gsum gsang ba bsam mi khyab de don rag pas phyag 'tshal lo ma 'ongs sgod ldan pho rme bye brtse ba chen pos bstsal ba yi gu ru'i thugs bcud me long 'di brtson 'grus drag pos nyams su longasaḥ sa ma shāḥshin tu dben pa'i gnas su phyin phyi nang gsang ba' dam rgya sdoms snang grags lha sngags chosaskur blta dal sogs bkod mdzes yid 'ong ba rdul tshon ras bris tshom bu gsum spros pa dang bstun gang 'os byaḥ sa ma māḥ 'di la spyi don gsum gyis bstan dang po rnam grangs brgyad du'oḥ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba na na moḥrig stong ma bcos don gyi dbyings dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje semasaX stong nyid ye shes dkyil 'khor laḥ mngon gyur rjen pas skyabs su mchiX gnyis pa sems bskyed na ཿ hoḥ grol dang 'khrul ba tha snyad tsam sangs rgyas sems can rtog pas bcos don la gnyis med chos kyi sku 'di don rig pas sems bskyed doX gsum pa tshogs bsags na ཿ na mo bcing grol med pa'i gnas lugs zhal mngon gyur rjen pas phyag 'tshal loḥ snang srid rig pa'i rgyan mchod 'bul rlung sems gnyis snang spros pa bshagasaX kun bzang

jo klong la rjes ye rang sku gsum mdzad pa rgya mtsha bskulaX phran las mo nub gsal ba 'dabasaX darga rtsa 'khar gsum dag par bsngoḥ kun khyab yi shas marngan (rwa gog ༷ bzha pa bgegs bskrad niḥ trīḥ brtan gam chos sku'i zhing bkod laḥ bgegs bdud mtshan ma ka nas dgaX 'on kyang gnyis 'dzin rnam rtog bdud tshogs drug rang grol glud gtor 'disaḥ zhen med dgongs pa mngon gyur nasaḥ 'od gsal dbu ma chen por sangasaX lnga ba srung spyor niḥ / trī byang chub thems kyi dkyil 'khor laḥ steng 'og phyogs mtshams spros pa bral 'jigs tshogs mtshan mas glags mi rtedaḥ don dam ye mnyam srung gur gtam dz+nya na dhardu rak+ta hūṃ drug pa brda sgo bye phyag dam bca' niḥniḥ sku gsum rang la ye rdzogs kyangaḥ ma rig rtog pa'i dbang gis sgrib bdag med shes rab rnon pos dbye ye shes rig pas brda phyag 'tshalaḥ da nas mi gtong dam bca' 'dzinaḥ pra we sha ya a ti pu hoḥ tsit+ta badz+ra hoḥ bdun pa byin 'bebs niḥ/ hrī mtha' bral klong yangs rdo rje'i zhingaXdri med thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas rig stong bla ma rdo rje sems dbyings

phyug bde ba'i dkyil 'khor dngaḥ ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'khor dang bcas 'dir byon dbang skur byin chen phob rtogs pa mngon gyur dngos grub stsolaḥ o badz+ra sa twa sarba sa ma ya dza dza a we sha ya āX brgyad pa mchod rdos byin rlabs niḥ / hrīḥ yul gyi gsal sgor bkod pa'i chos sna tshogs rgyan gyi bye brag kunaḥ ye shes rig pas byin gyis brlabs kun tu bzang po'i bkod par sprin oṃ āḥshā ha ho hrīḥ badz+ra spra ra ṇa dzaḥ sbyor ba sngon 'gra'i rim pa'oḥs ma mā rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa dngos gzhi rnam grangs bcuḥdang po ting 'dzan rnam gsum ni hūṃ trīḥ ka dag spros bralachos kyi dbyingasaḥ ma 'gags rang gsal snying rje cheḥ rig pa rten 'byung yi ge trīḥ thabs shes zung 'jug rtsal du bkodaX tshe ā hūṃ trīḥ gnyas pa gzhal yas lha bskyed na ཿhrīḥstong chen yum gyimakha' klong duX lhun grub 'byung lnga rnam dag gzhi ye shes lnga ru mnyam par sbyoraḥ bde stong zhing gi bkod pa niḥ brda don rtags kyi mtshan nyid rdzogs rang byung 'od lnga'i gzhal yas khangaX sgo gru rta babs gdugs tog mdzes phyi gsal nang gsal dri ma med 'khor 'das dpal yon 'ub chub dril yongs gyur dag snang dwangs

sgo ma'i skuX ngo mtshar rgyal ba'e zheng bkod dbusaḥ chags bral ge sar 'dab stong kharaḥ bsel zer re bong 'ardzan bzhad stengaḥ rag pa hūṃ bab spro bsdu yesaḥ'acha1 'das dpal yon 'ub chub drilaḥ yongs gyur dag snang dwangs ma'i skuḥ rig stong bla mardo rje semasaX dkar gsal dri med dung mdog zhal brtse chen thugs rje'i 'od stong 'khyugaḥ mkhyen dang nus pa'i 'dzum zhal mnga'aḥ ye shes gzigs pa'i spyan zung bkraḥ dbu skra thor cog zar bu 'phyangasaḥ sku gsum mdzad pas gdul bya 'dulaḥ rat+na'i dbu rgyan snyan cha dngaḥ mgul phreng do shal se mo doX phyag zhabs gdu bu rnam par mdzesaḥ dgos 'dod yon tan char chen 'bebaX dar gyi cod pan zi sdir dngaḥ stod g.yog smad sham dar dpyangs sprasaḥ gang 'dul mdzad pas 'gro khams 'dulaḥ tshul dgus 'gyur ba'i lang tsho canaḥ gdos por ma grub 'od skur sharaX phyag g.yas rig stong gser rdo rje ye shes thugs kyi stod du brtenaḥ g.yon pa snang stong dngul dkar gyiḥ dril bu chos dbyings gsung snyan niḥ dku la brten zhing mchog tu 'gyengaḥ dbyings phyug bde ba'i

yum dang sbyoraḥ gri gug thod 'dzin yab la stobasaḥ rus rgyan dar dang rat+nas spras bde dang stong ba'i gzi 'od 'bar thabs chen bde ba'i skyil krung bzhugasaX 'dor 'das mnyam nyid dgongs pa mdzad spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po ni kun bzang yab yum nam mkha'i mdogaX 'od lnga'i klong du skyil krung bzhugasaḥ mnyam bzhag rgyan bral chos dbyings ngang 'pho med de bzhin nyid du bzhugs phyi rim pad+ma 'dab bzhi laXshar du dga' rab rdo rje dkar parnyi ta yi cha lugs canaḥ rdo rje gdengs shing dril bu brtenaX zhabs gnyis brtul zhug rol ba'i bzhugasaX lho ru 'jam dpal bshes gnyen ser ral gri phyar zhing bhasto brten he ru ka pa'i cha byad canaḥ rgyal po rol ba'i stabs su bzhugs nub tu shrī seng ha dmar phyag g.yas sdigs mdzub g.yon bhasto rnal 'byor spyod pa'i cha lugs can zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugasaḥ byang du gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin mthing gsal rdo rje sdig mdzub mdzad thod skam dbu rgyan stag sham dang: rus rgyan dar gyi dpyangs pa 'phur dpa' bo gyad kyi stobs su bzhugasaḥ kun kyang

'o/ snang stong zung 'jug dalaḥ ye shes 'od lnga'e klong ya sa su dwangs gsal 'dzan pa bral bar bskyed de ya gye ram 'dab bzhe la0 rdo rje ren chen pad+ma lasaḥrdo11 bo dpa' mo yab yum brgyad phyogs mdog zhi ma khro 'dzum zhal bde stong zhal sbyor gar stabs bsgyur yab rnams lcags zhags sgrogs dril dang bhan+ta dku la brten pa'i tshulaX yum rnams gri gug thod khrag 'dzin yab mgul 'khyud cing zhal la stobs snang stong zung 'jug 'od skur sgomaḥ gzhan yang sangs rgyas byang sems dngaḥrtsa gsum dam can sprin ltar 'khrigs mkhyen brtse nus byin gzi 'od 'bar kun gyi gnas gsum rdo rje'i sgogaḥ yi ge gsum las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas thugs mchog rdo rje rigs kyi lha'iX phyag rgya yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyiḥ rnam par spyan drangs gnyis med bstimaḥ gsum pa spyan 'dren ni / hrīḥ 'og min nges pa lnga ldan zhingaX rang bzhina'od gsal gzhal yas nas don dam bla ma rdo rje sems ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'khor dang bcasaX don la gnyis med mnyam nyid kyang gdul bya'i mos

ngor spyan 'dren gshegasaḥ o badz+ra sa twa sarba sa ma ya dza dzaX bzhi pa bzhugs gsol na ཿhṝ gdod nas dre med chos kyi skuḥ gshegs bzhugs spros pa bral mod kyangaḥ dam tshig gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la ye shes mngon sum 'char bzhin bzhugasaX sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan lnga pa phyag 'tshal ba ni na 23 'ganas ma btsu sa lhan skyes lhaḥ kun bzang thugs mchog rdo rje sems dri med ye shes dkyil 'khor laḥ lhag mthong rig pas phyag 'tshal lo na mo na ma hoḥ drug pa mchod 'bul na hūṃ hrīḥ gzung bas ma gos phyi mchod sprinaḥ'adzin pas ma bslad 'dod yon lnga dug gsum rnam dag sman gtor raka rkyen ngan lam slong phyag rgya garaḥ rig stong rjen grol kun bzang bkodaX bde stong kha sbyor byang chub semasaḥ bdag gzhan rtog pa thugs rjes bsgral sgyu 'phrul ting 'dzin ltad mor 'phrulaX chos nyid spros bral de bzhin nyidaḥ ye mchod rang gzhin rol ba yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa rig stong bla ma rdo rje semasaX dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs dgyes phyir 'bulaḥ sku gsung thugs yon brin las bskang chags nyams rtog sgrib kun

'o/ sbyangs nasaX mkhyen gzegs ye shes dngos grub stsol o ma hā pañca pu dza ho0 bdun pa bstod pa ni sne rte rdo rje'i sku ne rdul dang bralaX dre med kun khyab zhal ma11 baḥ ma brtsal rdzogs ldan bkod pa cheḥ gdos bral 'od la phyag 'tshal loḥ rdo rje'i gsung ni 'gag pa med brjod pa tshig dang bral ba laḥ don kun mnyam pa nyid du stonaḥ 'ub chub brda yi klong la bstodaX rdo rje'i thugs ni chos kyi dbyings dri med mkha' ltar dag pa laX ye shes gzigs pa'i 'brin las canaḥ gang yang snyoms la phyag 'tshal bstod ngo bo kun bzang bkod pa laḥ rang bzhin ye shes sgyu 'phrul canaX mdzad pas 'khor ba dong nas sprugs ma rtog rdo rje sems la bstodaḥ dmigs med shes rab yab yum sbyor: thugs rje'i bye brag 'khor du 'gyed don la tha mi dad pa steḥ kun khyab rdo rje sems la bstodaX brgyad pa 'dzab dmigs ni hrīḥ pad dkar gdan gnas sems dpa' yi dri med thugs kyi dal dbus suḥ ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang baḥ rgyan bral gcer bu 'od phung 'baraḥ de yi thugs klong dbyangs gsal gyiḥ ga'u snang

stong zung 'jug sbubs rig pa hrīḥl sngags kyis bskor bzlas pas nyams chags sdig sgrib byang gzung 'dzin spros pa thad dar grolaX kun khyab ye shes mngon gyur ngang skye badz+ra sa twa āḥ dgongs pa chos nyid don la bzhagaḥ'aphro 'dusaganyis snang dri ma sbyangs gsal ba'i lha snang mngon gyur ngang ting 'dzin mi 'gag rtagasakyi dbang gzer chen bzhi yis 'dzab rgyun skyongs 'byu 'bum bzlasapas phyi nang dang gsang ba'i grub rtags bzang po 'byung the tshom med do sa ma ya dgu pa sgrub pa'i 'a ba dmigs niḥ / hrīḥ rang grol 'od kyis mdun bskyed bskulaḥ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus gsum gyi dbang byin dngos grub bsdus te bstim mar 'phros 'khor ba dongs nas sprugs dpal yon 'byung lnga'i dwangs ma bsdus gnyis su med par ro gcig bsre slar yang rig pa'i gzi 'od kyis snang ba dag mnyam lha ru sad grags pa sngags kyi rang sgrar shar dran rtog ye shes thugs klong ngang dkyil 'khor gsum du rdzogs sangs rgyasaX tshe badz+ra sa twa ba gu h+ya dz+nya na gar+bha sa ma ti sirnyi pha la hūṃ de bzhin nyid las ma g.yos bzhanaḥ rig pa ye shes gar chen bsgrur gang 'dul mdzad pas

sgor+sha) 'khor ba stong gsang ba'i nya ma klong nasashar bslos pa'i grangs tshad 'bum phrag bdun grub pa'i rtag mtshan bsam mi khyab sa ma yaḥ bcu pa las sbyor 'dzab dmig ni tshu ste thugs che ga (rgormi kyi dkyil 'khor lasaḥ 'od zer steng 'og phyogs bcur 'phros bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi phyi ru 'dul khrims nyams pa dag nang du lhung ba phog pa byang gsang ba dam tshig nyams chags grol khams gsum snang ba'i mtshan 'dzin stong thugs mchog nges pa lnga ldan du thams cad dag mnyams rdzogs sangs rgyasaḥ tshe badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs dgongs pa 'pho 'gyur bral ba yis yi ge brgya ba 'bum phrag bgrang gnad kyis nyams chags rtog sgrib byang bde chen thugasakyi sras su 'gyuraḥ sam yaḥ dngosagazhi bskyed rdzogs ram pa'oḥrgya rgya rgya rjes kyi rim pa bdun las dang po tshogs dzos yo byad rnams byin gyis tshosapar bya ba niḥ/ jeḥ bhasnyo stong gsum khyon mnyam dbusaX bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigs sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ru mosaḥ mtshan 'dzin rtog pa re ye dzaḥ sa gyi stong nyid nam mkha'i khyon ā las tshogs ston zad med spro nyu gis kun bzang mchod sprin dmigasaḥ hrī ༷yis lha

tshogs dgyes bskang gyuraḥ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa dzaḥ gnyis pa spyan 'dren niḥ / trīḥ chogs rdzas bkod pa sprin ltar gtibasaX rnal 'byor dgongs pa ro mnyam ngang gnas yul dur khrod bkod pa tshangaḥ 'di la ye shes lha tshogs dgyesaḥ mi gnas chos kyi dbyings nyid las0 gshegs bzhugs mtshan ma bral ba'i skuḥ rig stong bla ma rdo rje sems0 dmigs med shes rab bde ba'i yumaḥ ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'khor dang bcasaḥ tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol dur khrod rdzas chen bkram pa yang: dam tshigs nyams chags bskang phyir 'bul ༷ zhun chen rkang dmar bltam pa'i meḥ ma rig gzhi la sangs phyir 'bulaḥ sha chen tshil sbyar bdug pa yangaX tshul khrims rnam par dag phyir 'bulaḥ gar phye dza gad bha ling rnamasaḥ 'dod yon mtshan 'dzin dag phyir 'bulaḥ shes rab ma 'gags bkod pa yang gang shar rang grol rtogs phyir 'bulaḥ mchod bya mchod byed gnyis su medaX mnyam nyid rtogs pas thugs dam bskangaḥ tshe badz+ra sa twa āḥ ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo (ཿ gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni trī bdebar gshadags che bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas

shā kun gyi ye shes sku rig stong bla ma rdo rje semasaḥ yab yum sgyu 'phrul dkyil 'khor laḥ bde stong tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bulaḥ dam bskang tshe dbang dngos grub stso11ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pu dza ho bzha pa bar lags na hoḥ snang srid med pa chos sku'i klongaX rig pa gcig pur ka nas dgaḥ 'khor 'das ye grol phyag che baḥ mnyam nyid 'ub chub lhun 'grub zha'/ blos byas rtog pa'i sgrib pa kunaX so so rang rig rjen pas bshagasaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya ā lngababasgral las ni hūṃ trīḥ nga bdag mtshan 'dzin rū tra kunaḥ 'thar byed rig pa'i brtul zhugs kyisaḥ bdag med mnyam pa nyid du bsgralaḥ chos nyid dbu mar byang chub po sarba rū tra ma ra ya phaṭaḥ drug pa bstabs mchod ni sne hrīḥ thugs ni chosakyi dbyings dang mnyamaḥ sku ni bde ba chen po bzhugs gsung sgra 'gag med dkyil 'khor ngangaX dbyer med rdo rje sems dpa'i dalaḥ mnyam nyid don la gnyis med kyangaḥ gang 'dul mdzad 'phrin bskul ba'i phyiraḥ dam tshig rngams bstab 'bul gyis bzhesaḥ sarba pu dza sa ma ya ha hi hoḥ bdun pa tshogs snag deḥ hrīḥ stong nyad mkha' la shugs kyis 'groḥ

r+sha shwa zung 'jogag bsre lhun grub longasasku nges pa lnga ldan gyi zhing yid la byas te hūṃ hūṃ (༷ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaX zhes dbyings thig rig gsum mngon gyur gyi ngang nas rag pa /ཿsngon po'o rnam pa ra dwangs ma rwaX r+shags ye shes kyi lam nas 'pho ba ni longs sku'i dgongs pa dang 'brel ba'i zab gnad doḥ hrīX ma brtsal rdzogs ldan rgyal dgongs brda snyan brgyudaḥ bka' bab chu bo bzhi 'dus bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so 'pho ba'i gsang lam phyesaX sgyu lus phung po 'di snang zhen 'dzin grolaḥ bla ma yab yum dran pa'i mos gus kyisaḥ bag chags lus kyi 'phrang lam kun bsal nas ༷ bde ba can dang mngon par dga' ba'i zhing : rnga yab gling dang ri po gru 'dzin gnas sems pa'i mod la rnam shes rlung zhon teḥ chags thog bral bar rig pa'i mthu ldan nasaḥ rgyal ba gang de'i thugs dang dbyer med regag zhes yang yang gdab nas 'jig rten la gdung thag bcad de 'pho yul gang de'i thugs klong du bsres laḥ hrī hri hrīḥ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭaX dag pa 'i zhing khams yid kya 'dun pas bzung la chags sdang spangs nas bla ma'i thugs ye shes dang gnyas su med pa' trī yag da rnam shes dbyer med par bsres te dbu ma' lam nas 'pho yul gyi thugs dang ro gcag tu bsre zhing 'pho ba ni

shārwa shes me yi dkyil 'khor duḥ gzung 'dzin bsreg blugs phul ba'i mthus nyams chags sdeg sgreb sbyang ba dngaX rtog pa'e pon tan 'phel rgyas shengaḥ rlung se dus snang ba dbang du bsdusaḥ gnyis snang dgra bgegs brlag pa sogasaḥ 'phrin las rab 'byams lhun grub mdzodaḥ me dar g.yab cing dod don gsol de nas bstod pa bya ba niḥ / hrī lta spyod gtsang madrang sgong laḥ mtshan 'dzin bag chags sregs byed cingaḥ shar lo'i 'jig rten skyong mdzad pa'i asne ra tsa khyed la bstod: me wa 'bar ba'i dam tshig tu gyur nas bsreg rdzas lha'i zhal du bstabs pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig de nas bzod gsol ni ho me lha asne ra tsa dgongs ༷ bdag rmongs ma rig 'khrul ba'i lasaḥ lhag chad 'gal 'khrul nongs pa kunaḥ snying nas bshags so bzod par gsolaḥ yi ge brgya bas nyams chags bshags de nas sreg la bskyed pa na eḥ chos dbyings stong ba'i mkha' klong duḥ bde stong 'bar ba'i me yi dkyilaḥ 'od lnga lhun grub gzhal med khang sgo gru rta babs mtshan rdzogs dbusaX chags bral ge sar 'bum brdal kharaḥ bde ba'i rang bzhin sur+ya dngaḥ stong

chen tsan tra nya gang steng thugs mchog hūṃ las bskyed pa'i sku rig — nga bla ma rdo rje sems gzhung ltar lha tshogs ma 'dres gsal spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal rjes byon skyems phul ba 'di ltararo shā trīḥ kun khyab ye shes klong yangs nas sna tshogs dga' bzhi'i 'phrul rtsed duX zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i skyems: thugs mchog gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul:rtsa sngags mthar a mṛ ta kha hi: nyer gcig brjod la phul bar bya: phyi nang gsang mchod yongs rdzogs 'bulaḥ de nas rdzas gtso 'bul ba ni hūṃ trīḥ rig stong bla ma rdo rje sems ye shes gsang chen dkyil 'khor du dam tshig nyams chags bskang ba'i phyir sna tshogs 'byu yi mchod pa 'bulaḥ dgyes bzhes rnal 'byor rtog sgrib byangaḥ mkha' ltar dag pa'i ye shes zhalaḥ mngon sum mthong bar byin gyis rlobs rtsasngags mtharaḥ sarba pā paṃ da ha na dam tshig nyams chags nyes lhung thams cad shirnye ku ru ye swā hāḥ stong rtsa la sogs brjod par bya de nas rdzas 'dus 'bul ba na ཿ ( trī mi rtog ye shesabacom ldan 'dasaḥ dri med rdo rje sems dpa' dang ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'khor dang bcasaḥ dga' ston ro mnyam thugs rje

53 brtse bas dgongs su gsol ༷ rnal 'byor nyams chags sbyang ba dang tshe dpal yon tan 'phel rgyas shingaḥ rlung sems snang bar rang dbang sgyuraX dgra ba'e sa 'byung po zhi zhing stong ༷ don gnyis lhun 'grub dpal thob phyiraX sna tshogs rdzas kyi mchod pa 'bul khyed shes dad pas gsol ba 'debs brtse dgongs sgyu ma'i zhal mdangs stonaḥ dga' ston ro mnyam chen por bzhesaḥ mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsolaḥ rtsasngags mthar badz+ra sirnyi sam ba de puṣ+ṭa be gā bi dzā ye ghasma ba lwa ā yu ṣe pra ti ha ta ga ga na sarba pā paṃ da ha na nyams chags sdig sgrib thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā stong rtsa la sogs brjod pa ra bya de nas 'dod gsol gdab pa niḥ ho mkhyen rtse nus pa'i gter chen poX bcom ldan bla ma rdo rje semasaX ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'khor dang bcas thugs rje chen pos dgongs su gsol rnal 'byor bdag cag sgrub pa po'i dam tshigs nyams chags byang ba dang ཿ rtogs pa'i yon tan 'phel rgyas shing ༷ rlung sems rtog pa dbang du 'dus gnyis snang dbu mar sgrol ba dngaX sa lam yon tan mthar phyin teḥ gzhan phan phrin

las mtha' yas pa gegs med yid bzhin 'byung ba yiḥ gsol btab 'dod don lhun grub mdzodaḥ de nas gzhung gis bstod pa bya tshogs da skang gsol rgyas pa ra 'bul de nas gtang rag mchod pa ni las byang ltar ram sngags mchod 'bul gshegs skyems phul la dngos grub blangs bstod pa bya zhang bzod gsol phul de nas bsdu rim bya ba niḥ hrīḥ ye shes chos sku'i dkyil 'khe ra rnamasaḥ rig stong spros mtha' bral bar bsduḥ slar yang rten 'brel phun tshogs phyir rjes thob sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar bsgyuraḥ a ā phaṭa phaṭaḥ de nas bsngo smon bya ba niḥ ho: dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs kunaḥ dmigs med spros mtha' bral bar bsngoḥ 'khor ba rten 'brel sgyu ma'i mdangs sku gsum dgongs klong sangs rgyas 31gaḥ lan gsum de nas shis brjod bya ba na na moḥ byin rlabs mchog stsol rigs kyi bdagaX bla ma dam pa'i bkra shis shogaḥ dngos grub char 'bebasargyud sde'i dpalaḥ yi dam lha tshogs bkra shis shogaḥbade stong dga' bzhi'i dpal mdangs ngomasaḥ ma mo mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis shog gang bsam phrin las zogs med 'grubaḥ dam can rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shogaḥ don gnyis

sgo 'i mad bzhin 'bras bu spenaḥ zab gsang chos kye bkra shes shogaḥ dga' ston bya zhing smon lam gdab de nas me la'i gtang rag ni gzhung ltar mchod cang rdzas rnams 'bul de nasagar+shar+shadro skyems gtor 'bul na bsangs sbyangs byin gyis brlabs byas teḥsno two 'dzago rtag bdas bsnga dpal gyis 'tshoX bstan pa rted dang bkur sti bcasaX bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa'iphyiraḥ dam rdzas dpal gyi ba ling 'di drang srong rgyal po khyod la 'bulaX dgyes bskang rdzogs ldan lang tsho laX skye rgu spyod pa'i phrin las sgrubasaḥ rtsa sngags mtharaḥ sarba lo ka.asne ye sha ba lirte khā hiX nyer gcig rjod la phul bar bya bstod cing bzod gsol grub pa'i rjes bsdu rim bya ba 'ad ltar roḥ.a༈ tshangs pa 'dzago rtane mgon gyi srasaḥ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor dngabacas rang rang gnas su gshegs su gsol0 slar yang dus su 'dod don stsolaX badz+ra thu ye shes pa shar lhor gshegasaX dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par gyuraḥ de nas bsngo basmon lam ni sne ya shase mar ya' gzhal yas su nyon mongs sdig sgrib bsregs pa'i las 'dis mtshon dge ba 'gro la bsngoḥ phyam gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas gyur cigaḥ lanagasum

rjesasu shis brjod ni ka trīḥlas bzhi lhun gyisagrub mdzad pa ye shes me yi dkyel 'khor bzhengs gnyis snang ma rig dri ma bsregasaḥnyams chags sor chud bde legs stsolaḥphan bde 'byung gnasabastan pa dar der 'dzin 'dus sde 'phel rgyas zhing sbyin bdag mnga' thang dpal yon 'byoraḥphun sum tshogs pa'i bkra shis shogaḥde ltar bsregs blugs phul ba yis rnal 'byor lam gyi tshogs ོgas tes lam nyam rtogasamathar phyin cang don gnyi lhun 'grub the tshom med sam mā 'od gsal nyamasakya sgrom rgya las rang rig ston pa pad 'byung gis rtsal snang bu la pha phog gtad/phrin lasabastan 'gro'i dpal du shar rig pa mi ra sgrom du bcugaḥdri med ye shes ru bkodaḥsngag kyi bdag mo gnyer byang bcol thugs srasarig 'dzin dpal du smonaḥs ma yuḥrgya rgya rgya gu bye brda thim lhaḥzhes pa 'di 'ang zab chosal las 'phro 'dzomasapa'i pa ṇi'i ming can gyisabaskul ngor kho bo nus ldan 'dusapa rtsal kyis mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda' dag par phab pa'i yi ge pa ni skul ba po nyid kyisabagyes pa dge legs 'phel sabo maṅga lam̐

ba dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol ba lasaX rdo rje sems dpa' sgyu 'phrul dra ba' don dbang yad bzhen nor bu bzhugs soḥ—tshuX na mo gu ru pad+mā ka ra yeX zazhesazang〉glo ye shes dri med gzigs yo can mi rtog rdo rje thabs kyi skuḥdamigs med shesarab yum dang sbyor ye shes sgyu 'phrul klong la bdud rdo rje las kyi dkyil 'khor 'dir thog mar smin par bya ba'i phyir don dbang yad bzhin nor bu nyid ston pa mdzod ldan dpal las bskulaḥs ma mā sku gsung thugs kyi rdzas bkod rnams da la mjes shing snyoms par bkram bdag mdun bum bzlas bsags sbyangs spel rig me tor zhing bdag nyid lajug slob ma gral 'khod khrus bgegs bsal srung 'khor sgom la bden don bshad maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni kyaḥgasang sngags don chedan bla ma dgongs bdag cag skal ldan pho mo laX rdor sems sgyu 'phrul dra ba yi smin byed dbang mchog bskur du gsolaḥlan gsum zhu gnang ba na ཿe maḥ'adir tshogs skal ldan pho mo rnamasaḥsgo 'dir 'phrad pa tshogs re bsagasaḥgasang chen la mos skal ba bzangaḥdam srung tshe 'dir rig 'dzina'agrub ཿbdag gzhan gnyis med rdzogs sangs rgyasaḥ

de don shes nas spro ba bskyed sgo gsum ltos med bla mar 'bulaX snang srid sgyu 'phrul dra bar bltaḥ gsang lam don dam mngon gyur skyongasaḥ ngas ni khyod la dgongs rgyud kyi dbang mchog rgyal thabs spyi blugs su gnyis med rig pas bskur bgyi'oḥ skyabs sems tshogs bsags bya dam khas blangs pa niḥ e ma rig snyenang bla ma rdo rje semasaḥ ye shes gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor dngaX tha mi dad pa'i slob dpon dgongs bdag ni yang gsang sgor zhugs nasaḥ 'khor 'das sgyu 'phrul dra bar bltaḥ don dam ye shes dkyil 'khor las nam yang mi 'da' sa ma yāX dmachuniḥ.e maḥ skal bzang snod ldan rnamasaḥ spro ba bskyed la rig ngo skyongasaḥ ye shes gsang ba'i mna' chu 'diX lhag mthong rdo rje rnon po yinaX 'chad nyan dbang phyir rna bar gtig dam tshig dag phyir lce la bzhagaX lta sgom spyod phyir thugs gar reg: de don ma brjed rig pas srungasaḥ gzhan la gsang ba las rgya 1rdomasaX sa ma yā badz+ra yaka hūṃḥ tsit+ta na ra gan slob ma lhar gsal ye shes dbab sgrib dar bsal la rig me 'bul mthong ba bstan la lha ngo spradaḥs ma mā phyi dbang niḥ ( trī —1nga gsal bum pa

dze3 gzhal yas khangaḥ dri meda'od lnga'i ga'u rtsa mi rtog ye shes sems dpa' dngaḥ dmigs med shes rab dbyings kyi yumaḥ ye shes sgyu 'phrul 'khor du ngomasaX dzaX pa gnyis med tha midadaḥ sku gsum mnyam rdzogs bcud chen 'khyilaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaX lha dang skal ba mnyam pa dngaḥ snang stong gnyis mnyam don rtogs shog rtsa sngags mthar kwaya.a snyi ṣiñca maḥ gtso sku gtad laḥ / hrī mi rtog ye shes bcol ldan 'das sgrib med thugs mchog rdo rje sems: dmigs med shes rab yum dang sbyoraḥ yid chos dag phyir bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kwaya a bhi ṣiñca maḥ rigs bdag gto laḥ / hṝ gdod ma'i mgon po chos kyi sku mtha' bral dbyings kyi yum dang sbyoraḥdon la gnyis med spros mtha' bral/ rig par rtogs phyir bu la sbyinaḥ rtsasngags mthar kāya a bhi ṣiñca tsheX dgyes pa rdo rje'i dbang na ཿ ( hrī dgongasapa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyamaḥmadzad pa thugs kyi bstan pa stonaḥ ye shes sku la snyoms par mdzadaḥ bzhad mchog dbang bskur bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ṣiñca maX smra ba' nyi ma' dbang niḥ ( hrī: ji

ltar mkhyen zhing ji snyed gzigs shes bya'i gzhung lugs gsal bar mdzad don dam klong du dmigs su medaX 'jam dpal dbang mchog bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar kā ya a bhi ṣiñca tsheḥ 'od gsal mdzod kyi dbang na ཿ / hrī gang shar ma zhen nam mkha' che stong dang mi stong spros mtha' bral mi rtog ye shes rgya mtsho'i mdzod dṛ seng dbang bskur bu la sbyinaḥ rtsa sngags mthar kā ya.a bhi ṣiñca tsheḥ rdo chos dbang ni hūṃ hrī sgyu 'phrul lam gsang sems la rdzogs ye shes klong dgu theg pa'i mdzod rtog pa rdo rje chos dbang phyugaḥgasang bdag dbang mchog bu la sbyin rtsasngagasamathar kāyas bhi ṣiñca oṃ zhi dbang ni / hrī 'jigasatshogasalta ba thad gar chod dri ma rnams ni ye nas stong zhi mdzad dpa' bo yab yum kyi brda dbang dam pa bu la sbyinaX rtsasngags mthar kāya.a bhi ṣiñca tsheX rgyasadabang niḥ/ hrī 'brasabu chosamadzad nyi shu lngaḥ gdos por ma grub bum pa'i sku rgyas mdzad dpa' bo yab yum kyi thabs dbang dam pa bu la sbyin rtsasngags mthar kāya.a bhi ṣiñca yo dbang ga dpal ni / sdi snang srid 'a gar 'dasaganyis su medaḥ dbyings dang

ma dhu tir sgrol nga bdag za ba'i he ru gaḥ karma dpa' bo yab yum kyi don dbang dam pa /po rtsa dri med ye shes bcom ldan 'dasaḥ byang chub sems kyi bcud chen 'khyil skal shāmangon gyur shogaX rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wāk+ka.a bhi ṣiñca ā ma yig gtad laḥ/ trī skye ba med pa'i ngachos sku'i gsung mchog bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mtharaḥ wā a bhi ṣiñca mi ma yig gam laḥ phabyed las rgyas 'debs chen po steX longs sku'i gsung mchog bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar

'phrul so gnyis gsal bar byedaX don la ka nas dag pa'i klong: sprul sku'i gsung mchog bu la sbyin rtsa sngags mthar wāka.a bhi ṣiñca ā gsangadabang niḥ / trīḥ bdeb kun gyigasang lam mchogaX bha ga shes rab rgyal ba'i mdzodaX rgyu lam 'bras bu bde ba'i dbyingasaḥ phyag rgyas 'khor 'das 'dzin par byed zag med ye shes dga' ba 'khyilaX skal ldan bu mchog rnams la sbyinaX chags pa zag zad 'od gsal mthongaḥ bde stong rtogs pa mngon gyur shogaḥ rtsa sngags mthar tsit+ta pra dz+nya a bhi ṣiñca (ཿ don dab niḥ / hrī ka dag sprosabral bcom ldan 'dasaḥ dri med ye shes mkha' ltar dag zang thal chos kyi dbyings dang mnyamaḥ rtsal dang rol ba kun rdzob tsam don la ye mnyam chos skur grol 'di don tshig tu brjod pa bral mtshan ma de yis mtshungs zla dbenaḥ don dam nyag gcig ye shes dbangaḥ skal ldan bu mchog rnams la sbyinaḥ lhan skyes ye shes mngon gyur nasaḥrig stong zung 'jug don rtogs shog rtsasngags mtharaḥ sarba.abhi ṣañca trīḥ rtsaladabang ni hūṃ hrīḥ mtha' bral don dam nam mkha' cheḥ rig gdang 'od gsal lu gu rgyudaḥ 'gyu 'phro

'o/ dngos med shes rab gsangaḥ mngon sum snang bas 'khor ba stongaḥ gong 'phel gyi ni 'das pa dag tshad pheb a ti'i la sku mjal chos zad gdod ma'i btsan sa dābaḥ myur lam thod rgal gsang mdzod sgoX skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥ thob ldog bcu drug rtsal rdzogs te dri med 'od gsal mngon gyur shogaḥ a a ā pāṭa mtha' rten gyi dbang ni hūṃ hrī: 'khor 'das thab chub gzhong pa stse dbyings rig zung 'jug gtor chen bshamasaḥ sku dang ye shes rgyan gyis sprasaḥ skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bsaḥgrol sa dang po byang chub nasaḥ 'phrin las mkha' ltar rgyas pa dngaḥ chos sku'i mdzad par dbang bsgyur shogaḥ marnyal bha lirnyi a bhi ṣiñca oṃ ā hūṃ hrīḥ dam khas blangs shi dga' ston byaḥdes ni nye lam zab mo'i sgo ye shes dbang gi dpa la dang 'byor sa lam nyams rtogs rtsal rdzogs nas don gnyis lhun grub the tshom medaḥ sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye brda them snyi zhes pa 'di' chos 'di la las dbang bsod nams kyi 'phro 'dzoms pa pa ṇi'i ming gis bkra shis la reg rin chen gnyas pa'i skyes bcas bskul ngoraḥ bdag 'dra nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyas ye shes sgyu ma'i bdo mdzod las zhal bshus te dag pa ra pha ba pas yi ge pa ni sa marnya
bha tra ma ṇis bgyi pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma lam̐

sgo dag snang las dpal ldan rdo sdesems dpa'i ༷ brgyud 'debs ni na mo badz+ra satwa ya sgrib bral ye shes gzigs pa'i bcom ldan 'dasaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs ma rdo pa 'phrin las canaX dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' laḥ gsol ba 'debs so mkhyen nus 'bar bar mdzodaḥshar phyoges rdul bral rnam par dag pa nas bcom ldan mi 'khrug rgyal ba thugs rje can be+eḍūl lhun po mkhyen brtse'i zer 'bar laX gsol ba 'debs so 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzodaḥlha phyogs yod tan rin chen gter mdzod nas gter gyi zhal mnga' rin chen gtsug tor canaX 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad 'phrin mtha' yas laḥ gsol ba 'debs so srid las rnam grol mdzodaḥnub phyogesabadeldan pad+mo bkod pa nasaX sangs rgyas pad+mo snang ba'i dpal ldan paḥ chags sogs nyon mongs rba klong skems mdzad la gsol ba 'debs so srid zhi mnyam grol mdzod byang phyogs blta na sdug pa'i zhing khams nasaḥ ngan song dong sprugs spyong ba'i rgyal po ni gang 'dul mdzad pa 'phrin las chags thog bralaḥ gsol ba 'debs so 'khor ba'i

skye sgo khogaḥ rdo rje'i srog ldan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang 'phren las kun stsol dam can rgya mtsho laḥ gsol ba 'debs so phrin las rab 'byams sgrubs byin gyis rlobs shig nyams rtogs yon tan spelaX snang grags dran rigs lha sngags chos skur smin gdod ma'i kun bzang he ru ka thob shogaḥ de ltar gsol bawa byin rlabs 'jug nyams rtog yon ma 'phel bar nges bden rdzun lag ru longs dang gsal bka' 'di sngags kyi bdag mos srungasaḥ sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim snyiḥ zhes pa' sprul ba'i skutheg mchog rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor kho bo nusaldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung zinasnye yisabagyi pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba masgo leḥ

shā dag snang las sngon gtar 'bul ba brin las rgya mtsho bzhugs so na ma badz+ra satwa yaḥ (rngo( rwashi dkar dmar gtor ma skyems phud ༅mas sngags dang phyag rgyas sbya bsgyuraspebye lha gsal ting 'dzan brtan po yis zo dor pho nya brngan ni tsu dzaḥ stong gsum stong shi 'jig rten laḥ dbang mdzad lha klu dregs pa canaḥ tha tshig bsgrags nas 'bod do byonaX dam tshig mchog la gus bzhin duḥ bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa'i grogs su bzhugasaḥ rnam mang 'phrin las gang bcol don: thogs med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i phyir rgya ja dza gad skyems phud dngaḥ dkar dmar gtor ma 'bul gyis bzhesaX rgyal bstan rin chen srung ba dngaX sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar ba dngaX rnal 'byor sku tshe bsrings ba dang bshad sgrub yar zla ltar 'phel ba'i gang bcol 'phrin las rab 'byams sgrubasaX zhal bzhes thugs dam ma g.yel zhigaḥs sabo 'do ka shā la e rda bā ling ta kha kha khā hiX gtoraskyems gtsang sar gshegs par bya thabs des 'phrin las gang bcol donaḥ thogs med yid bzhin 'grub pa ra 'gyur rno nus byin rlabs bsam mtha' yas skal ba can gyi dpa la du shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu hraḥ brda thim

'dul pad+ma 'byung gnasaX gzung ma ye shes mtsho rgyalaḥ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs bdud 'dul sku yi phreng baX nus ldan dpal gyi rdo rje'i bar byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa zam ma chad pa 'dir brten zhing 'brel ba'i dmigs yul pho mo rnamasaX na rag mnar med kyi gnas nas drangs shing bskal mang skad cig la bsgyur nas rigs drug gis sa las dbugs dbyung ste rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i mdun sar 'khod phyir dmigs yul nyid kyis gsol ba gdabs par mos laḥ rigs drug gnas 'dren legs pa ra gtong sgyu ma lta bur ngo sprod ni kye ma kye spyod skal ldan sems kyi buḥ 'khrul ba'i snang shes gzhi med rtsa ba bral med la yod snang stong pa'i gzugs brnyan camaḥ rgyu gsum rkyen bzhi 'thus pa'i bag chags su ༷dug gsum dbang gis ngan song gnas gsum mchedaḥ zag bcas dge 'bras mtho ras rnam gsum snang mi g.yo'i las kyis gzugs dang gzugs med khams de rgyu de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gsungasaḥ sa da lam la dbye ba mang mod kyang 'dir ni rang byung rig pa ngo shes byaḥ mi dga' mi dgos dmyal ba ra sar zhogaḥ zag dang mi

bzhin gyi nor bu dbang gi rgyal pos mtshan par byas pa zhig lag tu 'byor bar mos laḥ a khaṃ bre ra hūḥ slob ma'i sgo gsum lha ru gsal ye shes bstim zhing brtan bzhugs gsol me tog tshom bu'idabus su dor rten 'brel brtag cing mtshan gdags ni 'oḥ me tog dbus su babs na rang byung sangs rgyasaḥ shar du babs na gdod ma'i ye gdangasaḥ sa ru babs na rin chen bsama'agrubaḥ nub tu babs na pad+ma chags bral byang du babs na mthong ba don ldan zhes gsol ba'i gsang ba'i mtshan de ma brjed par yid la zungs dang bar do'i skabs su yi dam gyi lha des gsang ba'i mtshan nas 'bod cing rjes su bzung ste rig 'dzin gyi sa la skyel bsu mdzad par 'gyur ro mig dar bsal ba grub rjes ngo sprod niḥ'o rigs kyi bu khyod ni marig pa'i sgrib pa rngams po che dang bral bar byas pa yin byis mig gnyis zum bus dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha' la ltos shig 'ja' 'od thig le mthing gsal 'khyil ba'i rnam par byung ba na rigs gcig rdo rje sems dpa'i sku 'grubaḥ dkar po mthong na zhi ba'i las dang sangs rgyas bde gshegs 'dus pa'i las 'grubaḥ ser po mthong na rgyas

'o/ pa'i las dang sangs rgyas rin chen rigs kyi yon tan mchog 'grubaḥ dmar po mthong na dbang gi las dang gsung pad+ma rigs kyi dkyil 'khor dang lha'ajedraḥ ljang khu mthong na drag po'i las dang mngon spyod lhun gyis grub pa'i da la mjal bar 'gyur roḥ bum dbang bskur ba la bum pa thogs te 'oḥregasakyi bu rnams bum pa rang byungagi gzhal yas khang phyi gsal nang gsal sgo gru rta babs sogs mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus suḥ bum bcud bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'od lnga'i kha dog mer gyis 'khyul ba'iklong rang byung ye shes kyi lha rnams 'od kyi sku ru bzhugs pa khyod la dbang bskur ba tsam gyis bag chags sgyu lus kyi mtshan ma rang sar grol teḥ dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje semasadapa'i gsang ba gsum dang tha mi dad par mos pa mdzod rjes su ngo sprod ni 'oḥregs kyibu rnams la bum pa ye shes kyi bcud chen po'i dbang bskur bas dug lnga rang sar dag phung po lnga'i nyes pa las grol rang byung zhing khams lnga'i sgo 'byed bde gshegs sku lnga lhun gyis grubaḥ ye shes lnga dang ldan phrin las rnam pa lngas sems can gyi don rgya chen

po 'byung bar 'gyur roḥ lha dbang ni 'oḥ rigs kyi bu rnams mtshan ma brda yi lhar snang 'di dag ni thabs su mtshon pa tsam ste don du rang byung ye shes kyi lha sku gzod ma nyid nasarang chas su bzhugs pa nyid ngo rang thog tu sprad pa yin te tshul de ltar du shes pa'i dam tshig rnam par dag pa dang ldan par mdzodaḥ lha dbang yongs rdzogs kyi rjes ngo sprod ni 'oḥ regasakyi bu dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyang g.yin na med deḥ lhan skyes byang chub kyi sems ci'i ngo bor ma grub pa'i gsal rig brjod du med pa 'di ni dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' 'oX rang bzhin ye stong ka dag gi rol ba 'di ni yum nam mkha'i dbang phyug ma'oḥ chos nyid kyi ngo bo la sku bzhi 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub pa 'di ni 'khor gyi rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'oḥ zag med don dam pa'i ye shes dga' bzhi dang stong pa'i 'od gsal dmigs su med pa 'di ni dpa' bo yab yum brgyad do rig stong gdod nas ye sangs rgyas pa 'di ni mnyam gnas mnyam nyid kyi bdag po rigs 'dus kun tu bzang po yab yum moḥ tshogs brgyad 'gags med du gsal ba'i shes pa rang sar rang grol

par ba rnams ni byang chub sems dpa' brgyad doḥ'abyung ba yul brgyad po mi dmigs par rang sar grol ba nyid ni byang chub sems ma brgyad doḥdug lnga ser sna da1 1ga rnam par dag pa nyid ni sprul sku thub pa drug goḥrtag chad mi bzhi dang skye gnas bzhi rang sar dag pa nyid ni sgo skyong yab yum brgyad doḥnyon mongs pa'i rtog pa ma spangs rang sar grol ba 'di nyid khrag 'thung drug cu'i lha tshogs kyi rol pa'oXrang lus rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dal teḥrtsa dag pa dpa' boḥrlung grol ba dpa' moḥthig le rnam par smin pa mkha' 'gro lhun grub sgo brgyad kyi snang cha thams cad mnyam gdal ka dag tu shar ba rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sku ru sna ba'oḥdes na phyi ltar sna grags rigs gsum lha sngags chos nyidaḥnang ltar rtsa rlang thig le dkyil 'khor gsum ldanaX gsang ba don dam rang byung ye mnyam sangs rgyas su bzhugs pa ngo rang shes ngang mngon gyur gdegs grol thob rtogs grol dus mnyam༄ patha' grol klong yangs chen por rtogs pa phul du phyin par gyis shigaḥbhan+ta bdud rtsi sbyin teḥ'o rigs kyi bu rnams dum gcig bhan+ta rang

byung gi gzhal med khang yangs pa'i dbus su bla ma yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i byang chub kyi sems bcud dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa rdo rje'i sgob ma la sbyin pa'i mod la bde stong mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i 'od gsal ngo 'phrod cing sa zin par gyis shig0 rjes su ngo sprod niḥ 'oḥ rigs kyi bu rang babs brjod med kyi don niḥ bde la chags pa dang bral ba gsal la ma 'dres pa stong la ma rmugs pa zung 'jug brjod du med pa mtshan ma'i yul du ma gyur zhingaX rang grol mnyam gnas su ye sangs rgyas pa 'di ga gsung gsang ba'i dbang gi mnyam bzhag gi ngo bo yin pas ngo shes par gyis shigaḥ ngang rtogs par mdzod la myong ba gting nas thon par gyis shigaḥ rig ma'i gzugs bas tsam bstan teḥ'oX rigs kyi bu rnams yid rig ye shes kyi phyag rgya bde ba'i rnam rol du bzhugs pa nyid gzugs brnyan gyi phyag rgya'i rnam rol du 'phos pa yin gyis0 de'i mkha' gsang stong nyid kyi don la rtse gcig tu zhog cig rjes su ngo sprod ni 'o rigs kyi bu dngos rig la 'du shes gsum ldan gyis sbyor ba dang yid rig la bde chen sems kyi sbyor ba'i brda

shārwa thabs la brten te dga' bzhi dang stong bzhi'i 'od gsal ngos zungs la ngang du mnyam par zhog dang srid pa'i mdud rgya las grolaḥ bag chags kyi gnasasteng mtshan ma'i zag pa zad mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i dga' bde'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur zhing srid pa tha ma ru gyur nas rang snang 'od gsal gyi zhing khams la dbang 'byorabar 'gyur roḥ shel dkar dang 'od lnga'i zig le'i brda thabs bstan te 'o rigs bu mtshon byed ni shel dkar dri ma med pa ste mtshon bya don rang byung ye shes spros bral ka dag tu gnasapa nyid doḥ mtshon byed ni thig le mtshon bya don snying po gzhon nu bum sku'i ye shes stong gsal mdangs lnga dang ldan pa rang byung thig le'i nyag gcig spros pa'i grwa zur lasa'adas pa'i ye shes nyid du la zlos shigaḥ rjes su ngo sprod niḥ 'oḥ regs bu mtshan ma'i spros pa thams cad thad gar chod la dbyings ye grol nam mkha' lta bu dang stong gsalabarjod du med pa'i ye shes kun la khyab bdal tu 'khyil ba'i rang grol thig le chen po'i sku yang dag pa steḥ 'di nyid rtogs pas srid zhi ka dag tu mnyam brdalaḥ 'khor ba ming

med du sangs rgyas gzhi grol thig le nyag gcig tu 'ub chub gdod ma'i sangs rgyas 'dus ma byas pa gzhon nu bum pa'i sku can dang tha mi dad par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro gtor dbang la gtor ma thog pa teḥ 'oḥ rigs kyi bu rnams sgrub dang dkyil 'khor thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo gtor ma rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i gzhal med khang mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i dbus suX lha tshogs thams cad 'od kyi sku ru bkra dpung nge byin thibs se bzhugs pa las bdud rtsi'i dkar dmar mthing ga'i rnam par mer gyis byung nas khyed rangarnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa dgaḥ sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog thobaḥ dug gsum gyi spyos pa'i 'gro ba rnams la gang la gang 'dul gyi don rgya chen po byed nus par dmigs laḥ gtor dbang bskur ro rjes su smon lam niḥ hoḥ smin par gyur cigaḥ grol bar gyur cigaḥ thob par gyur cigaḥ dag par gyur cig skye gnas kyi bar dor dam pa'i chos la 'da' bar gyur cigaḥ rmi lam gyi bar dor 'od gsal 'khor yug du 'dres par gyur cigaḥ bsam bstan gyi bar dor bskyed rdzogs ting nge 'dzin gyi gdeng

'o/ chen po thob par gyur cigaX 'chi kha bar dor 'pho ba'i zab gnad kyis ye shes chos kyi skur sangs rgyas par gyur cigaX chos nyid bar dor longs spyod rdzogs pas ( mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa thob pa ra gyur cigaḥ srid pa bar dor 'khrul ba rang grol sprul pa'i sku thob ste sangs rgyas par gyur cigaḥ don gnyis lhun grub kyi gter la mnga' brnyes par gyur cigaḥ 'khor ba dong sprugs su byed pa'i ded dpon du 'gyur par shog cig rtsa sngags mthar kwa ya a bhi ste yanaḥ wāk+ka a snyi ṣiñca āḥ tsit+ta a bhi stenyu ྅ཿ sarba a bhi ṣiñca hrī gawa yang smon lam rgya cher gdab de nas 'dod yon byin rlabs ni ram̐ ye dzaḥ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar zas sna 'bru sman dar zab dkor nor yo byad rgyan chas ma tshang ba med pa mig 'khrul lta bu'i longs spyod zad pa med pa'i gter rang rang gi yul spyod dang mthun pa 'dod yon gyi phung po nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyuraḥ ā sno badz+ra spra ra ṇa sa rjes su zas gtad na tshe 'das shing lus brjes pa'i dmigs yul ma ye sa par nyon cigaḥ sngon 'das pa'i dus na o rgyan sangs rgyas

gnyis pa zhal bzhugs dus bdud blon tā ra klu gong tshe 'das pa la rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis 'dod yon sna tshogs pa'i zas gtad phun sum tshogs par bshamasaX 31 rgyan chen pos bden pa'i chos bshad ngan song gi gnas las drangs zas bsngos phun sum tshogs pa'i mthu la brten te nyes pa sna tshogs las grol bar mdzad pa dang yang rang rig bla ma rdo rje thod phreng rtsal dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i rnam rol du bzhengs te dus snyigs ma'i sems can rnal 'byor nyams chags rtog sgrib bag chags ngan pa can rnams rang 'khrul sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur zas gtad phun sum tshogs pa snang bar byas bde chen grol ba'i sa lam bstan te 'khor ba'i sgo chod par mdzad pa dngaḥ da lta rnal 'byor ba bdag gis gsang chen dkyil 'khor gyi gzhung bsrangs tshe 'das rigs drug gi gnas nas rim par drangasaḥ bden pa'i dros bshad cing smin grol gyi dbang bsnar myong grol phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlabs pa'i zas gtad 'di dag0 khyod kyi pha ma bu dang bu mo zhing po sgru mo la sogs nye rang

shā brtse ba can thams cad kyis gdung ba'i mchi ma phyungasaḥ brtse ba'i ngag bton mchog gsum ra mdar sbran nas 'bul zhing bsngos pa yin pas khyod 'khor(1 1nas la ma chags shigaX ma zhen cigaḥ gnas 'di dang khyed gnyis 'brel ba med pas grogs dang dkor nor gos rgyan bya spyod thams cad la ma chen par bde mchog mngonapar dga' ba'i zhing khams su 'dun pa gtod cigaḥ rtse gcig tu bzhud cigaḥ der skyes nas rang byung chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' lung dbang khrid dam pa yongs rdzogs su thob ste mi'agyur kun tu bzang po'i sa mchog mngon du brnyes par gyur cigaX smon lam sna tshogs gdab la bsngo ba'oḥrnam shes spar chog ga dmigs pa ni 'oX dmigasayul gyi phung lnga 'dus pa'i ngo bo 'odalnga'i thig le hūṃX yig gis mtshan pa can du gyuraḥ de nyid rtsal po ches mda' 'phangs ba bzhin tu shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams su thugs mchog rdo rje semasadapa' yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba'i lhums su zhugs te sku yi gsang lam nas brgyud bde ba chen po'i sras su sangs rgyas bar gyur cigaḥ.ā phaṭaḥ.ā phaṭaḥ.ā phaṭaḥ smon lam dri

med yang dag gdab 'brel tshad don ldan nyid du gyur skal ba can gya spyod yul te rig pa 'dzin pa'i dpal du shogaḥ sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thimaḥdzi zhes pa 'di'ang lung zina'agyur med rgya mchesarin chen byu ru dang bkrashis lha reg kyi skye bcas bskul ro ra kho bo nusaldan dpal gya rdo rjes mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni snying norashe rdzisabagyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo la/

dadz+nyāX dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol pa laḥ rdor sems sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rtsa tshig gi smon lam dang ngo sprod gdab pa bzhugs so/sgo na mobadz+ra satwa yāḥ rme//sgo/thardosasngo// mi rtog ye shes bcom ldan 'das rig stong bla ma rdo rje sems sras bcas zhi khra'i wa tshogs la khyed ses dad pa sa phyag bgyi'oḥ bcom ldanabyed zhi khro rab r+sāms kyi rtsa tshag ngo sprod smon lam ni na mogu rtsa dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' dang sgyu 'phrul zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal loḥ bdag lus sgyu ma lta bu'i grong khyer na lus gnas lus las ma skyes zhi khro'i dalaX dus la bab nas 'pho ba'i skabs 'byung tsheḥ khug pa dang po chos dbyings ye shes lamaḥ ngo bo rtag pa'i mtha' grol de bzhin nyid mngon par dga' ba ming tshig spros pa dgaX de bzhin nyid dbyings rang ngo shes par shogaḥ khug pa gnyis pa me long ye shes lamaḥ rdo rje sems dpa' 'ja' bzhin lam merashar kha mig bzhin lag gdos po'i mtshan ma grol lhan skyes rdor sems rang ngo shes par shogaḥ khug pa gsum pa mnyam nyid ye shes lamaḥ ston 'khor zhing khams ma 'dres

lam mer mchedaḥ nga khyod bdag gir blta ba'i dngos po medaḥ 'og min gnas der btsan sa zin par shogaX khug pa bzhi pa sor rtog ye shes lamaX brjod med a ni yig 'brukun gyi mchog skye 'gags 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung su snang dgongs brda snyan brgyud rang ngo shes par shog rkyang ba gcig pu bya grub ye shes lamaḥ sku 'od zhing la rig paphar 'jug ste dpyod shes gzung 'dzin spros pas ma gos paraX bar do med par kun bzang 1nga grol shog de ma grol nas 'byung ba'i thim sdud kyi khug pa dang po sgo lnga rnamashes thim smig rgyu me khyer du ba 'ja' 'od 'khrigasaḥ chos dbyings ye shes grol lam zin par shogaḥ khug pa gnyis pa rnam shes snang bar thimaḥ dmar lam mkha' la glog 'oda'akhyugs ltar mchedaḥ snying stobs las byung rtog pa rang sar gyes me long ye shes grol lam zin par 31ga khug pa gsum pa snang ba mched par thimaḥ dkar lam skar khung zlazer 'dren ltar mchedaḥ rdul las byung ba'i rtog pa dbyings su sdud sor rtogs ye shes grol lam zin par shog khug pa bzhi pa mched pa nyer thob thim mun gros 'thibs

r+shar) ltar nag lam snang ba 'charaḥ gti mug las byung rtog pa rang gshis nubaḥ mnyam nyid ye shes grol lam zin par shog rkyang ba gcig pus khrag rnams rje do ra 'dusaḥ rlung ni phyir gyes gdangs rtsal snying dbus thimaḥ rig pa snying dbus kun gzhi'i khams su brgyalaḥ de tshe bya grub grol lam zin par shog nyer thob las sangasanam mkhar thim pa'i tshe gdod ma'i ye gdangs spros dang bral bar 'char ngo bo sku la kha mig mtshan ma medaX rang bzhin 'od gsal 'od lnga ris chad bral thugs rje'i rig pa ma bang bu 'jug shogaX ka dag dang po'i grol sa ma zin nas nam mkha' 'od gsal nyid la thim pa'i tsheḥ gang snang za 'og bkram ltar mched pa'i dus nam mkha' rnam dag sgron mar byang chub shogaḥ 'od gsal zung 'jug nyid la thim pa'i tsheḥ rdo rje sems dpa' sku tshom thig ler sharaḥ chos dbyings ye shes 'od la rtse gcig gtadaḥ dmyal ba'i rgyudalam dud khar zhen med shog snang ba mtha' yas sku tshom thig ler shar sor rtog ye shes 'od lam bkrag mdangs 'bar gnas dman yi dwags 'od lam dmar skya mchedaḥ

'jug ldog mi rmongs grol lam zin par shogaX rnam par snang mdzad sku tshom thig ler shar me long ye shes 'od lam dkar gsal 'tsheraḥ gti mug dud 'gro'i rgyud lam sngo skya mched blang dor mi rmongs grol lam zin par shogaḥ don yod grub pa sku tshom thig ler sharaḥ bya grub ye shes 'od lam ljang gsal 'tsheraX phrag dog lha min rgyud lam ljang skya mchedaḥ 'jug ldog mi rmongs grol lam zin par re gaX rin chen 'byung ldan sku tshom thig ler shar mnyam nyid ye shes 'od lam ser gsal 'tsheraX nga rgyal lha yi rgyud lam ser skya mchedaḥ 'jug ldog mi rmongs gnad gsum gyis grol shogaḥ zung 'jug ye shes nyid la thim pa'i tsheX steng na ka dag snang ba mkha' ltar yangs rma bya'i gdugs ltar 'od gsal phyogs mtha' yasaX rig pa der 'dus 'dzin med 'od gsal laX rtse gcig gtad nas nang dbyings zin par shogaḥ rdo rje sems dpa' dri med khong gseng lam thig le dkar po kham phor ltar brtsegs 'char me long ye shes gting mdangs ldan par 'charaḥ mi 'khrul thugs kyi 'bras dbang mngon gyur shogaḥ snang ba mtha' yas bde stong
