la yo la rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can zhi 'dzum brtse ba'i nyams dang ldan pa longs sku'i rgyan bcu gsum gyis spras shing zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa 'od dang 'od zer mu med pa 'phro bar gsal ba'i gnas gsum rdo rje'i sa bon las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros 'og min nas rnam snang ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ dzaḥ/ baṃ ho gnyis su med par gyuraḥ slar yang dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum 'khor dang bcas pa 'od zer gyis bskul te mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par mos la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba gdab nasaḥ 31 badz+re bha wa a bhi ṣiñca (ཿ zhes dbang bskur rdo rje semabakadapa' gtso bor gyur ba'i dbu brgyan par gyuraḥ yo badz+ra pus dhu pe a lo ke gharnye nai wi t+ya shabha'i b.ragyis mchodaḥ / snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i klong mi bskyod ye shes ngo bo nyidaX sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs 'dzin paḥbacom ldan rdo rje sems la bstodaḥ cesabastod tshe badz+ra tsa3 tsanyu sa man+ta tsanyu bhi shwa dha na ye swā hāḥ zhes brjod la spyan dbye tshe gi hūṃ swā hāḥ zhes brjod pas bskyed pa'i lha rnam

tshang snang 'od du zhu ba las bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rten so so'i rnam par gyuraḥ gnas bya'i rten gyi snying po yi ge(ཿgsal ba la rten 'brel snying pos bskor ba1 7da zer gyis don gnyis byasaḥ slar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa sku rnam snang dngaḥ thugs mchod rten gyi rnam par byung nas dam tshig gi rten rnams dang tha mi dad par mos la0 na mo gu ru badz+ra a k+to bh+ya yaḥ o hūṃ hrīḥbhi dzaḥbadz+ra bha wa dri rte tiṣ+ṭha bī khaṃ swā hāḥ na mo rat+na tra yā yaḥ ye dharma he tu pra sogs sha ma ṇaḥ slo su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā0 sbrel la stong ngam brgya rtsa brjod dbyangs gsal nyer gcig kha bskang slad nongs bshags yig brgya lan gsum brjod sngags mchod phulaḥ trī chos dbyengs skurashes ngo bo nyidaḥ rnam par snang mdzad bcom ldan 'dasaX 'khor ba dong sprugs thugs rten dalaḥ dbyer med mnyam pa nyid la 'dudaḥ gsol gdab ni kyi mgon po jogs sangs rgyas kun kyang dam tshig rten gyi dkyil 'khor laX ci srid 'byung bzhis 'jigs bar du mi g.yo brten par bzhugs su gsolaḥ zhes gsol ba gdab la phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems

dpa' bla ma ye dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung ma dang bcas pa bdag la dgongs su gsolaḥ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas par mya ngan las 'das pa'i sar ma bzhag gi bar rten 'di rnams la bde bar gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa bzhugs su gadregalaḥ bzhugs nas kyang tshe 'das 'di nyid kyi gtsor byas pa'i 'brel thog sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa chen po las bskyab nas rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che mchog myur ba nyid du thob par mdzad du gsol lan gsum brjod bkra shi ci rig pa sa mtha' brgyan cing me tog 'thor la dge bsngo yang dag par bya'o 'dibyasabasod nams bsam mi khyab gang zhig 'gro ba'i rgyud sbyangs shing rnam grol sa la reg par 'gyuraḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim lhaḥ zhesapa 'di'ang lung zin pad+ma chos 'phel rgya mtshos bskul ba dang nye char slob bu sgrub brtson sa marnya bha tra ma ṇis bskul ba don dang ldan phyir kho bo bdud 'joms bshad pa rtsal gyas dag snang sgyu 'phrul rol ba'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba' ya ge pa ni snyang nor me tri'i mtshan can gyis bgyis pa dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma leḥ

phra yanalag bdun pa ni bcom ldan 'dasamagon po mi 'khrugs pa sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogasade dag thams cad laX mchod yon dang byugs pa me tog dang brder+sha sposaḥ mar me driX zhal zas dang rol mo gdugs dang ba dan ༷ rgyal mtshan dang 'phan yab dar gyi lda ldi dang pad phreng bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa'i stong gsum 'jig rten gyi bkod pa thams cad bdag gi blo yis blangs te gus 'dud dad phyag dang bcas nas 'bul bar bgyi'oḥ bdag gzhan semasacan thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad la gnong zhing 'gyod sems dang bcas pas mi 'chab mi sbed par bshags sbyangs byas te slar sdom par bgyid lags soX zhing rab 'byams kyi rnam dkar dge ba'i tshogs zag dang zag med ci bgyis pa thams cad la rjes su yi rang ngoḥ bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon dam pa thams cad sku mya ngan las mi 'da' bar yun du bzhugs par snying nas gsol ba 'debs soḥ 'phags pa so skyesanyan rang thams cad la rang rang bgo skal dang mthun pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po

bla na med pa bskor bar bskul loḥ bdag gzhan gye dusagasum du dge ba'i rtsa ba ce bsags pa thams cad mkha' khyab kye 'gro ba yongs la bsngo bar bgye'oḥ kun kyang phyam gcig du bla med yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob pa'i rgyur gyur cigaḥ zhesapa'ang snying slob mun sel gyi bzhed don grub phyir nu ldanardo spel ba dge legs su gyur cig nga mchod bsdus ni shar phyogasami 'khrugasabakod rdzogs zhing khams la ༷ dbang mdzad mi 'khrugs bkod rgyal sras dang bcasaḥ dad pa'i mos ngor tshogs kyi zhing du byonaḥ khyed shes dad pa drag pos phyag 'tshal loḥ snang srid dpal 'byor 'dod yon rgya mtshos mchod sgo gsum sdig sgrib nyes lhung ci mchis bshags rnam thar mdzad pa rgya mtshor rjes yi rang gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bar bskulaḥ rgyal ba sras bcasamya ngan 'da' med bzhugasaḥ bdag gzhan dge tshogs mkha' khyab 'gro la bsngoḥm lus kun mkhyen mgon po'i sa thob shogaḥ ces pa 'ang mi 'khrugs pa'i mchod chog gi kha bskang du nus ldan rdo rjesaspel ba maṅga leḥ dza yan+tu

tshang gakhrus rna/ khrus kyikhang pa shin tu dri zhim pa: sogs ltar bltam pa tsam sogs ston pa bla med sangs sogs thabs mkhas thugs rje sogs mar+shar+sha palidagochogs sogs hrīḥ mar rgad lhun por rta sogs mdo dzadabyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs su bcad/ ched brjod gleng gzhi rtogs brjod de ltar byung /skyes rab rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab/ gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis smra bsam brjod med shes sogasa'ajam dbyangs phyag na sogasawa rang dgra bcom rtsa gsum khrusam gsung yang rga rgya gar paṇa chen bod sogs kun bzang rdor sems dga' sogs 'og min chos kyi dbyings sogs bdegashadags thams cad sogs zhikhro yi dam sogasamamo mkha' 'gro sogs bdag gitshe rabs kun sogasaspyod che o rgyan sogs skor gyidabang phyug sogs debazhen gshegs pa sogs rgyal ba'i sku gsung sogs dodag sku la sogs denasade la sogs 'dinikhrus mchog sogs rka ka ni bzla bgo khrus 4 bayo rnal 'phyor ba'i chags nyams rtogs

sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ gshin po'i las ngan bsag pa'i rgyun dag ste lusher ba'i gnas stong par bsam/ rten gyi rang bzhin la dri ma mi mga' yang sems can gyi gnyis 'dzin blo yi dri ma dang phung po'i rdul ka nas dag par bsam la/ bum chu 'thor/ gzung sngags rnams ni na mo rat+na dra yā ya/ 61 ke ka ni sogasayo ga brgya/ sa bipul gaste sogs gar+bhe swā hā/ o pad+mo dha ra a mo gha dza ya te tsu ru tsu ru swā ྅ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba durga te sogs na mo rat+na dra ya yā na mo bha ga wa te a mi ta bha ya sogs na mo bha ga wa te gu ru be+eḍūr+ya sogs na mo rat+na dra ya yā na moX ār+ya dz+nyā na sa ga ra sogs o du da ha da ha sarba na ra ka ga te he tun hūṃ phaṭaḥ ma bre pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka oṃ tri ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka 61 su pa ra mu tan khaṅga tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭaḥ tso(z-i pa ra mu tan khaṅga tshisnyo tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa oṃ a pa ra mu tan khaṅga tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa 'a ajigaḥs maḥnya tshe 'das kyi las sgrib bag chags thams cad shīrnyi ku ru swā snya slar dmigasapa'i dal 'od du zhu nas rus pa la thim pas tshe 'das ngan song gsum dang 'khor bar skye ba'i sgo chod par bsam mo/
ge rdo dag snang las bde chen zhing gi sgrub pa'i lhan thabs ske0r+ya'i bla bre bzhugs:

shā na mo a mi haṃ bha hrī drucusgyurtos sto tshe dang ye shes dpag med pa 'od mtha' yas la gus pas 'dud de yi sgrub la 'dug pa'i tshe lan thabs 'di nyad gces par zungs sa ma pā /shā byin rlabs ni hrīḥ rin chen sna bdun las grub bum pa ni: thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang mdzes klong pad zla nyi ma bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i khar: stsalngang las byung khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil khro mo rlung 'byen bde stong 'khril sbyor rol dur khrod chas rdzogs phra rab rdo rje'i rdul: spro bsdus dam sri 'byung po 'thar bar dmigs: hū —4 ta kṛta tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa nyer gcig brjod lha rnams 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i rol bar dmigs 4 byung ni bsang sbyangs byas la hrī: dmigasamed stong pa chos kyi dbyings nyid las rol ba 'gags med kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin: 'dod yon lha mo bsam yas rol gar bcas bde chen zhing gi dkyil 'khor bskang phyir spel: ma sarba bita su ra su ra badz+ra spa ra ṇa kho: mjasngags rgya chen spros la spel spos byung ni hriḥ sme med dbyings lasamadzes pa'i gar ngoms pa: rdo rje lha mo sbos me sbo ba mo: kun bzang ye shes lnga yi bdug sprin 'gyed mi gtsang nyon

shā mongs kun rtogs sang gyur cig /sang salesang nge ye swā hā: dam tshig 'dzin pa na yo mi'agyur sku yidam tshig phyag brgyar blta: 'gags med gsung gi dam〉rgo ༷la bu dkrol: 'khrul bral thugs kyi dam tshig rdo rje bsten: thabs shes gnyis med 'gro ba'i don la bzhugs: sgo badz+ra ghasnyedharma hūṃ 'a byin bskul na mos ldan rnams kyidad pa'i mthus bskul te bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa nas tshe dang ye shes dpag med kyi 'phrin las can bcom ldan 'od snang mtha' yas sras 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te bdag mdun sgrub pa'i rdzas rnams la sib sib thim par mos la: sgo pad+ma sam yā dza sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: / sdi 'og min dbusamatha' bral ba'i dbyings: ye shes nyid la ye shes kyi bkod pa ris med mnyam rdzogs nas kun bzang yab yum byin phob cig /'od gsal lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing: bde dang stong pa zung 'jug dal: 'gags med brda dpe'i spro bstu 'gyed: rdo dze+e'achang chen byin phob cigaḥ ma chags rdul dang bral ba'i zhing: pad+ma 'bum 'khrigs bkod rdzogs pa rgyal kun gsung gi gsang rdzogs dal:'od

snang mtha' yas byin phob cig rnga yab mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gling dpal ri 'phags bod paṇa grub rje: sangs rgyas gnyis pa thugs rje'i gter: pad 'byung yab yum byin phob cig /dhu ma tha la mkha' 'gro'i gling: bde chen ye shes spyod pa can: ṭāk+ki 'bum gyis spro bsdu 'gyed: jo mo mtsho rgyal byin phob cig /dza lasmyo ra'i rgyan gcig pu: byams dang snying rje'i gter mnga' ba: gdul dka' 'dul ba'i 'phrin las can rtsa ba'i bla mas byin phob cig dgongs pa brda dang snyan brgyud kyi: rje btsun gu ru rig 'dzin rnams: sku yis gar bsgyur shigs se shig gsung gi brda chos 'u ru ༄/ thugs kyis gzigs pa mtha' yas pa'i: 'ja' dang 'od phung lam se lam: dngos grub sbrang char nyi li li: nyams dang rtogs pa ban ma bun: gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang bskur 61 a mi dhe wa a lū sarba sa ma yā phem phem: zhes mos gus tshad med pas dbang byin dbab par bya'o dam rdo rgyal ba'i 'phel gcing dang skye bdun sku sha mtshan nyid can sha lnga bdud rtsi chos sman rigs sel med bsags pa'i ril bu ni dbang gi rtsi gsol shel bum bzhugs da la'i dbus bkod 'di ltar sgrub sa ma yā hrīḥ rang byung 'od

shā kyi gsal gzhal med khang: brda rtags bkod pa phun tshogs dbus: myong grol ril bu'i mtshan 'dzin sbyangs: ma chags pad zla nyi ma'i khar: bde gshegs (rdo nga mtha' yas pa: dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i zhal: mtshan dang dpe byad lang tshos 'khyud: bcu gsum longs sku'i rgyan gyis spras: tshe mda' g.yas la tshe bum g.yon 'khor 'das dpal yon dwa sa ma dril: rang 'dra mu mtha' yas par 'gyed: khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas yul sbyangs: bde ldan pad+mo bkod par smin: gang gi bsnyen zhing sgrub pa'i dal: mthong thos dran reg rnam grol gyi: sa dang lam la sbyor mdzad pa: zab don sngags kyi chos nyid yin: ma sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā pañca oṃ a yudz+nyā na ma hā pukhye tiṣ+ṭha sidhi ma: dbang bskur rgyas gdab ni hūṃ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las dngos: dbang bskur rgyal po bde ba che: ye shes lnga ru byin rlobs shig sa 〉ཿswā iḥsnya sum̐ lāḥsum̐ bye rta: ma sarba ta tha ga ta a snyi ṣe ka te sa ma yā bṛXye sa: ma: gang gi snying la bzhugs pa yi: rnam par mi rtogs ye shes la: rgyal ba'i

gsang gsum rgyas thob la khams gsum sku gsung thugs dbang bskur: 31 sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra su bhā wa ad+ma ko3 nya: slar yang gnabangagasum la bzhugs pa'i: dam tshig yi ge'i 'od zer gyis: dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba sras dang bcas sbyan drangs gnyis med ro gcig gyur pad+ma sa ma yā dzaX hūṃ baṃ ho hū hrī byamasamage thugasarje'i nyi ma 'od po che: bder gshegs gsung gi dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das: thugs rje lcags kyus bskul lo gnas 'dir byon: byams pa'i zhags pas dam tshigs dal la bzhugs: dga' ba'i sgrog gis gnyis su med par bsre: btang snyoms dril bus 'khor ba'i gnas stong mdzod: sa sarba ta thā ga ta trī sh+ya ho: sa ma phe : sa ma yā s+t+waṃ rme dre med gtsang sbyar lha yi sbos ldan chab: rgyal ba'i sku dang zhabs bsil brtse bas bzhes: bkra shis rtswa mchog ku sha'i gdan bting ngo: bdag cag byang chub lung bstan gnang phyir bzhugs: yo pad+ma sa ma ya dza 〉 baṃ ho sman mchod ni oṃ uhā chos dbyings dgongs pa'i gter la mnga' brnyes pa skye 'gags 'gyur med kun bzang yab yum la dngos

maX kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i sman mchod 'bul: tshe dang ye shes dpag med dngos grub stsal: rang bzhin 'od gsal brda yi mdzod 'dzin pa: mi 'gyur lhun po rde ༷ 'chang dbang la: dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i sman mchod 'bul: tshe dang ye shes dpag med dngos grub stsol: bder gshegs gsung gi bden pa mchog grub pa'i 'od snang mtha' yas rdul bral rgyal ba la: dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i sman mchod 'bul: tshe dang ye shes dpag med dngos grub stsol: dpal ri o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling nas: mi mjed zhing gi skyabs gcig pad 'byung la dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i sman mchod 'bul tshe dang ye shes dpag med dngos grub stsol rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje btsun mo'i mkhar: bde stong 'dzum zhal bzhad pa'i mtsho rgyal la: dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i sman mchod 'bul: tshe dang ye shes dpag med dngos grub stsol spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan gcig pu bka' drin mtshungasabral rdo rje slob dpon la: dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i sman mchod 'bul: tshe dang ye shes dpag med

dngos grub stsol: rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed rgyal ba'i zhing: rtsa gsum rab 'byams sprin gyi phung po la dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i sman mchod 'bul: tshe dang ye shes dpag med dngos grub stsol: phyi nang gsang gsum 'brel ba'i gnas yul nas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje'i srog ldan la: dngos kun bdud rtsir shar ba'i sman mchod 'bul sgrub 'bras mngon du 'gyur ba'i dngos grub stsol: ma hā sarba pañca a mṛ ta khā hi khaṃ rdo rje lce la gnas pa'i zhe dmar pos: rgyal kun mkhyen nus brtse ba'i ཿ mthing bskul phyag rgya rdo rje thal mo oṃ gyis bsre: zag phung dwangs mar smin zhing grol bar mdzod: kā ya sirnyi slo: wāk+ka sirnyi ushit+ta sirnyi hūṃ sarba sirnyi hrī bsnyen 'dzab na bum pa 'od kyi gzhal med khang yangs shing rgya che bar bzhugs pa'i bder gshegs gsung gi dkyil 'khor rab 'byams las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis: brtan g.yo'i snang zhen bag chags las nyon gyi sgrib pa mtha' dag sbyangs bar dmigs la: bsnyen sngags mthar pañca a mṛ ta a we sha ya ā āḥ sgrub 'dzab ni sgo snang srid sku ngas khyab kyi gzhal med khang bkod pa phun sum dzadzhags

dze/ pa'i dbus su gsung mchog rgyal ba 'od mtha' yas pa'i sku re re las kyang brgya stong khri 'bum bye ba sa ya dung phyur grangs med pa spros te: snang srid 'jigabyed bye khams thams cad g.yo 'gul byed cing: 'khor 'das kyi dpal yon dwangs ma thams cad sib sib rug rug tu bsdus la gnyis su med par bsres te dngos kun bdudartsi'i rnal 'byor grub par migs la: sgrub sngags mthar a ra pa tsa mi ta trīXd ye swā hā: las 'dzab ni bdag nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i 'od zer gyis bum pa gzhal yas khangagi lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul de rnams las spros pa'i 'od zer gyis 'gro ba rigs drug gi brtan g.yo'i sdug bsngal sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs thams cad gsang ba gsung gi dal du sad nas gsang sngags kyi rang sgra bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar 'u ru ru ti ri ri bzlas pas: rgyal kun mkhyen nus brtse ba'i dbang byin dngosagrub thams cad cig char du thob par dmigs la las sngags mthar yin sarba ta thā gā ta ma hā pa ñca oṃ ā yudz+nyā na ma hā pubye tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi hūṃ: sgre pra we sha ya phaṭa: a we sha ya a ā

dngos grub bskul ba ni hūṃ trīḥ byamasabartse'i gter chen 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon sdug bsngal rming gzhig bde ba mchog gi gnas: 'od snang mtha' yas rdul bral rgyal ba dgongs bdag gis bsnyen sgrub bsgom bzlas chud ma gsan: thun mong grub pa brgyad kyi dngos grub dang: khyad par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dbang: ya mtshan rmad byung dus 'dir stsaladu gsol: thugasal le lo btang snyoms mi mdzad par byams mgon thugs rjes nye ba nyid du zungs tshe 'di nyid la rig 'dzin sa thob shog lga hā pad+ma a dṛ ta a bhi ṣiñca al la ho: srung ma'i mchod gtor byin rlabs ni gtor snod bhasto lcang lo can yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag las byung ba ngo bo zag med ye shesakyi bdud rtsi la rnam pa chos skyong rang rang gi yid spyod dang mthun pa'i 'dod yon phun sum tshogs par gyur: slo ā& ha ho hrīḥ badz+ra spra ra ṇa khaṃ bskang rdzas byin rlabs ni oṃ sarba dharmā ga ga na ā mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong ru phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs ston bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid nor sna nye ba'i rin chen mched bskang brten sgrub kyi rdzas

shā 〉 lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor 'dod dgu'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa kun tu bzang po'i dga' ston nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngags lanashes da rten snying bshe da la spel bar bya'o tshogs bsgral ni na re mchog gsum rtsa gsum bden gnyis bslu ba med pa'i mthus: sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe zhing sems can gyi bdeskyid bcom pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad dam tshig gi rdzas 'di la khug cig dza hūṃ baṃ ho: lag zhus mi bran dang dbang phyug rnamasasngon kyi bka' tha tshig sbran phyir zhal chab gnangabar zhu zhes bskul nas byin rlabs ni pañca a bro ta hūṃ ha ho hriḥ lag sdud bka' yi pho nya rnams: 'du ba chen po'i pham 'bab la: gshegs shig byon cig a ra l+li hrīngaḥ dza phernyi bskulagator byin rlabs ni a las pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'dod yon lnga ldan gyi phung por gyur: tshe āX shā:ha ho hrīḥ pha mdo byan rlabs na rdo rje'i srego ldan bka' sdod pho nya'i dmag tshogs rnams la thugs dang mthun pa'i chad mdo bka' yi gtor ma ting 'dzin 'phrul gyi longs spyod phun sum tshogs par gyur: brtan gtor byin

rlabs ni rin po che'i snod du dkar mngar sman gyi phung po 'dod yon bdud rtsi'i skyems mchod thugs mthun dgyes bskangs kyi bdud rtsir gyur: tshe āḥ/: lan gsum bro 'gugs ni na mo: dkon mchog gsum dang rtsa gsum chos skyong srung ma'i bden pas: gnod sbyin dam sri rgab 'dre log par 'dren pa thams cad gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og rol du khug cig dza hūṃ baṃ ho: gtor sgod btegs pa'i dus su bkra shis bsod nams snod kyi nang: phan bde'i char gyis gang bar dmigs: spreḥ.a yu pukhye puṣ+ṭi ku ru ye swā hā gting rag gimachod pa la bdag bskyed las spros pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo grangs med pas kun tu bzang po' dga' ston nam mkha'i mkha' klas par spros te mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mtha' yas par mchod cing bskang bar mos la: mchod pa rgyas par phul rdo rje lha mo rnams kyis mdzes pa'i sku yis gar byed cing: snyan pa'i rol mo sna tshogs 'grel te tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyi rta la drangs te lha tshogs rnams la bstod mchod phul bar bsam mo: shis brjod dus su rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer spros te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba

shā sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rgyud bskul te mdun gyi lha lam yongs su gang bar byon zhal nas bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs ti ri ri sgrogs cing phyag nas me byed n+ta ra ba'i char chen po bsnyil bar mos la rten snyang da shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o smon lam ni na mogu ru hūṃ: phan bde'i 'byung bstan pa dar gyur cig der 'dzin 'dus sde'i sku tshe brtan bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang rgyas bshad sgrub mdzad 'phrin mkha' dang mnyam nad mug mtshon 'khrugs rgud pa zhi rdzogs ldan snang bas sa gsum khyab tat+yathā: pañca dri ya a wa bho dha na swā hā: srung ma'i mchod gtor byin rlabs man chad sgrub gzhung gzhan las khol du byung ba'o nus ldan rdo rjes bras

shā dag snang las bcom ldan 'das rdul bral shin tu rnam par dag pa lagasol ba 'debs pa las nyon rdul grol bzhugs —11 —— na mo a sa/ bha ya: rathathograshugasgorgya khyed shes dad pa drag po yas gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa mi na mo a mi rta bha ye: grangs med gong nas thugs bskyed bsam yas pa'i: mthong thos dran reg rnam grol sar 'god phyir: bde chen pad mo bkod pa'i zhing bzungs ba'i: mgon po 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs: thar ba'i lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs: sngon tshe dgeslong chos kyi grags pa yis: sangs rgyas rin chen gser 'od snang ba'i drung: bskal pa gang ga'i klong gi bye ma snyed: 'gro don ngal ba lhur len zhal bzhes pa'i rgyal ba 'od mtshan 'bar la gsol ba 'debs: thar ba'i lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs: sku be+e dkyil 'khenar pad+ma rā ga'i zhal mtshan dpe'i nyin byed stong gis 'byud pa'i 'dzum: rtag par 'gro 'dren 'phrin las mi nub par: rdul bral rnam par dag la gsol ba 'debs: thar ba'i lam sna zin par byin gyis

rlobs gsung gsang 'gags med dam pa'i chos mdzod las gdul bya rjes bzungs bdud rtsis dbug dbyung nas bde chen rnam grol sa la 'god mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas pad+mo'i snang bar gsol ba 'debs thar ba'i lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs: gang na 'tsho zhing gzhes pa'i rgyal ba de'i: mkhyen brtse nus pa'i 'od zer stong 'bar bas 'khor ba sdug bsngal grong khyer brgal mdzad pa'i sangs rgyas gser 'od snang la gsol ba 'debs: thar ba'i lam sna zin par byin gyis rlobs: bdag la bzang ngan las kyis 'brel tshad kun bag chags las ngan dbang gis mi bsgyur bar: lus ngag yid kyi 'dzin zhen rang dag nas: bde ldan pad+mo bkod par skye gyur cig theg chen chos la rtag tu lhur len zhing phyir mi sdog pa'i rig 'dzin gral zin nas sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan rtsal rdzogs te gdul dka' 'dul ba'i ded dpon byed par shog de ltar gsol ba sus btab kyang las nyon dri ma kun dag ste nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan rgyas don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim (sgo/ zhes pa 'di'ang sngon smon las kyis 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor pa o

pa ra ༷ rgyan bstan 'dzin nas bskul ngor nas bo sbasapa'i rnal 'byor nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyangs snang mkha' 'gro'i bdo mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lu zinasadresabagyis pa dge legs 'phel/(1 r+sha lam/

—1) dag snang las bde chen zhing chog giston gtor 'bul ba bkra shis char 'beb bzhugs:——1) na mo a mi rta bha ya: maskogashunanirdo khya dkar dmar gtor ma ja cha skyem sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyang sa bsgyur spel ltar gsal ta 'dzin brtan po yis srung ma gzhi bdag mdun du gsal tha tshig bsgrags pa 'di lta ste hūṃ dza stong gsum stong gi 'jig rten khams dag na: sa la nga che gnam la ngas bdag pa'i: dkar nag gnyis skyong dregs pa rgya mtsho rnams: rgyal dbang pad+ma'i tha tshag ji bzhin du: rnal 'byor bdag gi mdun sar da tshur 'dus: bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i grogs mdzod la: phyi nang gsang ba'i 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog/rnam mang 'phrin las re 'dod char bsnyil phyir: dkar dmar gtor ma ri ltar brjid ldan pa: ja chang btung ba gting zab rgya mtsho'i skyems gus pas 'bul lo dgyes pa chen pos rol: bdag cag dpon smob yon mchod 'khor bcas la: gnas mgron po yi dam tshig brtse gdung gis: bya ra mel tshe sang sgobs ma g.yel zhig /gnyer bcol dam

las ma g.yel sa ma yā zhesabarjod gtor skyem gtsang sar mchod gnyer bcol phrin las thogs med 'grub sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim ('i zhes pa 'ang dpon po o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ngor kho bo nubaldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa na lung zin mi dris bgyis pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba masgo lam/

'o/ dag snang las: bgegs la chang glud bsngo babadud rtsi'irgya mtsho bzhugs shā namo a ma dhe wa hrī: tha40chesaX ran za snod du cha glud da bgegs kyi gtor ma bshams pa la 'bras ba sha thud zas snas brgyan sngags da phyag rgyas byan rlabs ni sbyo las rim jun po'i snod du oṃ las gtor ma zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i phung por gyur a āḥ/ hūṃ hrī phyogs mtshams stong 'og bcu ru rgyu ba yi: sa 'og sa steng sa bla'i gdon dngabagegs dbang chen khro rgyal bka' byung dam la 'dus: sngon las 'phral rkyen lan chags sbyang ba'i glud: 'dod yon lnga yi phung po 'di khyer la rang rang so so'i gnas su bdebar dengs: gal nyami 'gro gnod cing 'tshe byed na: phung por rdo rje'i mtshon cha'i char phab ste: rdul cha phra mo bzhin du brlag 'gyur ro: sarba bhu ta byang ta khā hi: gsadhu pes loke ghan+de rna wi bye shabha ā hūṃ: sarba bhistso gats+tsha bka' bsgo dam — sgrags thun gyas brabs srung 'i gur thu dam rgya bcad byin dbab mchod rdzas yo byad spel des mi sgrub pa gegs med 'grub sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu

rgya brda thim (6) zhes pa'ang dad ldan o rgyan bstan 'dzin nas bskul ngor nu ldan 'dusapa rtsal gyisamakha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur 'i yi ge pa ni me dris bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel/sarba mgi lam/

sgo 〉 bgegs la bka' bsgo ba na hūṃ snyi kun gzhilingang las las rlung g.yos pa'i gdon: nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i 'dre bo che tshogs drug rang grol glud gtor(1 1 'dis: ngoms shing tshim nas dbu ma chen por sprad: hūṃ hūṃ u tsi ta ya phaṭa: nyu bzhe sngagasabarjad thun gyis brab de nas srung gur phub pa ni hūṃ nyi yenas dag pa chos sku mnyamabardal klong: phyogs dang ris chad bdag gnyis mi dmigs kyang: rlung sems phra bas 'phar sdang mtshams srung phyir: lhag mthong rig pa'i ye shes ra gur gtams: dz+nyā na dha rak+ta rak+ta spro na brda sgo dbye ba ni ho gnyug ma'i sha༄ rig ma 'gags sa le bar: sku dang ye shes ngo bor lhun grub kyang rlung sems 'phral byung ma rig ling tog skyon: don dmabla ma'i man ngag mthu yis bsal: yin dz+nyā na tsakyu pra we sha ya phaṭa: brda phyag 'tshal ba ni /: yinas gnyes med chos sku dag pa'i klong rang bzhin rang 'od gsal ba longs spyodardzogs: thags rje cir yang sngang ba spral pa'i sa: dbyer med rang ngo mjal la phyag bgyi'o: sa ma yu na mo a la la ho dam 4'a bzungs ba ni na ma kun bzang dgonges pa zang

thal de bzhin nyid: rig pa srog gis bsdus pa'i lu gu rgyud: ngo 'phrod ngang bskyangs gdengs thob rtsal rdzogs bar: nam yang mi gtong sgog gi gta' ru 'dzin: sa ma yā ti ho 'di yang sgrub pa'i cha lag tso dbon po o rgyan bstan 'dzan ngor nusaldan 'dusapa rtsal gyis smras yi ger me dris bkod pa dge /sarba ma lam/
— pa dag snang las bde chen zhing gi sgrub pa ngan song dong sprugs thar ba'i sgo 'byed zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

shā na mo a mirta bha hrīḥ rwathatsāshasgagi1je/ dkyil wor bkodamadzes rten mchog bkrams yon chab sbos dang mar me bkrams bkod pa khyad 'phags yid 'ong bya sngags da bye zlos yid 'ong spel sa ma mā 'di la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las dang po las rim lnga yis bstan sa ma mā skyabs su 'gro ba ni mdun kyi nam mkhar nub phyogs bde chen pad mo bkod pa'i zhing bams rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du bzhugs par gsal gdab la: na rmo khamasagasumarigs drug mtha' yas sems can rnams: mgon po 'od dpag med pa 'i lha tshogs la: byang chub snying po'i bar du skyabs su mchi: kun nyon 'khor ba'i 'dam las bskyab tu gsol: lan gsum sems bskyed ni ho: nam mkha'i gar khyab pha ma sems can rnams: 'khor ba sdug bsngal gsum gyi btson ra las bde chen zhing la mngon par byang chub phyir: smon dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed bslabs la gnas: lan gsum tshogs bsags ni na mo baglu med mgonamachog 'od snang mtha' yas la: bdag lus rdul snyed grangs sprul gus phyag 'tshal dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul:

shā thogs med nas bsags sgo gsum sdig sgrib bshags mgon khyod rnam thar rgya mtshor rjes yi rang: gdul bya'i khams dbang chos 'khor bskor du gsol byer+sha rdong de sras mya ngan 'da' med bzhugs: dge tshogs gcig bsdus 'khor gsum dag par bsngo: 'gro rnams bde chen zhing du byang chub shog /byin 'bebs ni hūṃ hrī: chags sogasardul bral bde chen pad+mo bkod: ngo mtshar rgyan gsum bkra ba'i zhing gi mgon: mthong thos dran reg 'dren pa'i dam bca' can: gsung gi dbang phyug 'od snang mtha' yas pa: sras bcas ye shes gzigs pa'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: gnas 'dir byin phobs dbang bskur rtogs pa spor: don gnyis 'bad med lhun gyis grub mdzod cig /snye a mi tam+bha sarba bīt+ya dha ra a we sha ya pho pho mchod sa byin rlabs ni 37 u3: ngo mtshar zhing sgobakod pa phun tshogs dbus: rnam mang phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa'i sprin mdzes sngag mthong bas yid 'phrog lha mo bcas: bde chen zhing gi lha tshogs bskang phyir spel snyen a hūṃ na maX sarba ta thā ga ta smo bi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod sngagasalan bdun gyis spel sam mā

rgya rgya rgya gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i las rim la rnam grangs bcu gsum dag gas bstan sa ma pā lta bskyed na ces rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan 〈snang pa nyid: bde chen ye shes byang chub sems kyi rtsal:rdul bral rig pa trīdamar zhu ba las: chags bral pad+mo bkod pa'i dal du rdzogs: badz+ra tsit+ta sa ma ti hū trī stong gsal bde stong yum lnga'i mkha' klong du: bde chen zhing gi bkod pa rab 'byams sprin rnam thar rgya mtsho las bsngags ji bzhin du: ma 'dres rang gsal blta na sdug par shar: rin chen sna bdun 'od 'bar gzhal med khang: rtsigs pa 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba dang drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab sgo dang rgyan: rta rkang chu skyes sgrom dang za ra tshag ri dwags chos nyan chos 'khor gdugs tog mdzes: phyogasalhung bral ba'igadugs chen rgyal mtshan dang: ba dan rnga yab pad skor rdor phreng dang mtsho rdzing ldon shing bya dang ri dwags tshogs: rtsed 'jo bro gar snyan pa'i chos sgra sgrogs: lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor spran phung 'khrigs: 'dod lnga rang grol mchod pa'i lha mos bstod: drang srong rig 'dzin rgya mtshos bstod bsngags 'ur: 'od gsal gzhal med khang mdzes de yi

7༷ dbus:rma bya brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin chen khri:sna tshogs pad+ma zla nyi kha sbyor steng:hrī las byung ba'i bde gshegs gsung dab phyug/rdul bral rnam de ba 'od snang mtha' yas rgyal dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i phung po la nyin byed 'bum gyis 'khyud pa'i bkrag mdangs 'bar mtshan da dpe byad brgyad cus rnam par spras mdzes pa'i rgyan bzang chos gos rnam gsum klub:srid zhi mnyam rol rdo rje skyil kru bzhugs mkhyen gnyis gzi 'bar mnyam bzhag lhung bzed 'dzin:mi g.yo lhun po ri rgyal bzhin du brjed:'od dang 'od zer mu mtha' yas par 'gyed g.yas su snying rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs:dkar gsal pad+ma 'dab brgyad shel 'phreng 'dzin:g.yon du gsang ba'i bdag po mthu chen thob:sku mdog sngon po rdo rje pad sdong bsnams:gnyis ka bzhengs stabs longs sku'i rgyan chas spras:'ja' 'od zer 'khrigs gdul bya'i yul la phyogs:de sras byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs kyis bskor:ngan song gnas stong 'gro 'dren mdzad pa skyong:thugs grog las 'phros 'od zer lcags kyu yis

nub phyogs bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa nas gsung mchog rgyal ba sras bcas sbyan drangs bstim: spyan 'dren ni hūṃ hrī: chags pa'i rdul bral pad+mo bkod pa nas: 'das pa kun kyi gtsug rgyan snang mtha' yas: sras bcas 'gro ba'i don du spyan 'dren na: 'khor ba dong nas sprugs phyir gshegs su gsol: skyi a mi dhe wa ā yu sirnyi sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra sa ma yādza dza: bzhugs gsol ni hūṃ hrī nyon mongasardul bral ka ma la yi gdan tsha grang gdung sel nyi zla kha sbyor steng gsung gi dbang phyug mgon po 'od mtha' yas: gdul bya'i dpaladu dgyes par bzhugs su gsol: sam ya ho sa ma mā stu: phyag la' ni na mo grangasamed gong nas mngon par byang chub kyang thugs bskyed smon lam dag pa'i 'phrin las su bskal pa rgya mtsho dbyings su ma stong bar rtag khyab 'gro don mdzad la bdag phyag 'tshal: na mo phyu ru sha ya ho: phya mchod na hū hrī lhag bsam dag pa'i ting 'dzin las 'khrungs ba'i: rdo rje lha mos pad+ma'i char sprin spro: rin chen ṭakris dri bzang sbos sprin 'gyed pad+ma'i dgyes sdes dbang gi sgon me bltam: las rab phyag rgyas bsil chab dri mchog byug:

'o/ bud+dha'i rigs kyis ro mchog zhal zas 'byed: sna tshogs ḍāk+kis dbyangs snyan rol mo 'brol: gsung mchog rgyal ba dgyes phyir gus pas 'bul: 'gro ba'i do( 1da thugs rjes brtse bas bzhes: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par shog: o badz+ra puje dhu pe sogs shabha pra titrī āḥ /: nang mchod ni hūṃ hrī: ting 'dzin las 'khrungs bde dang stong pa'i gzugs: mdzes sdug blta bas mi ngom a dwar sproḥ snyan 'gyur tshangs pa'i glu ldan rta bu sgrogs: tshul khrims bde ba mchog bskyed dri bzang byugazhis mngar nus pa stong ldan lha yi zas: bsil ldan bde 'jam reg bya pañca li gsung gi rigs mchog snang mtha' yas la 'bul: bdag gzhan bsod nams tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes: ma badz+ra du pa shabha gharnye ra sa spar shwe pra tisto u/: gsang mchod ni hūṃ hrī: lhan skyes bde chen dga' bzhi'i 'dzum g.yos gar: sgeg pa mo yis rgyal ba'i thugs rgyad basmal: 'gying mas gdul bya'i yul la 'brin las spel: gla mas gsung gsang chos kyi char rgyan 'bebs: gar mas log rtog 'byul ba'i 'khor lo sang bsod

nams dpal spel bkra shis rdzas rtags dang:rgyal srid nor sna ting 'dzin gter sprin spro:'od snang mtha' yas 'gyed pa bskang phyir 'bul gdul bya'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir brtse bas bzhes:skyod badz+ra lwa su mā le ghirti nirti rat+na maṅga lam sarba byu dza spa ra ṇa sa ma yā āḥshā:sman raka gtor mchod na hūṃ hrī bcom ldan rdul bral 'od snang mtha' yas la gdul dka' nyon mongs rgyas pa'i sems can gyi:dug gsum 'khrul ba ka nas dag pa'i phyir:zag med bdud rtsi sman raka gtor gsum 'bul:'gro ba'i tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir brtse bas bzhes cha badz+ra pañca a mṛ ta rak+ta bha lirnyi khā hi bstod pa na hū hrīḥbacom ldan rdul bral shin tu dag pa'i sku:sor rtogs ra gzugs pad+ma ra ga'i zhal:mtshan dang dpe byad rgya mtsho'i dpal 'bar ba'i:rdo rje'i rang bzhin rgyal ba'i sku la bstod rang bzhin 'gags bral brjod med nā dā'i sgra:gsung gsang chos kyi dga' ston gdul byar 'gyed:ma rig mun sangs spangs rtogs mthar phyin pa'i:rdo rje'i rang bzhin rgyal ba'i gsung la bstod:thugs ni mkhyen nus brtse ba'i gzi byin 'bar:nam

'o/ mkha'i mthar gtug gdul bya'i zhing khyab pa'i mdzad pa 'phrin las thugs rje nub med gter: rdo rje'i thugs mchog kun khyab klong la bstod: gags pa ni bye danyis 'dzin ma rig 'khrul bas dbang gyur te: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa dang: bying rmug 'thor 'byams ting 'dzin 'gal 'das skyon: mi 'chab gnong zhing 'gyod bcas bshags bgyi'o: badz+ra sa ma yā āX bsnyen 'ad ba ni hrī bdag nyid 'od snang mtha' yas thugs ka phu pad+ma zla steng rdo rje'i lte ba rtsa dbyangs gsal nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor sbubs: rig pa hrīḥl rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas sgo gsum las nyon dri ma sbyangs: 'gro drug 'khrul ba'i gnas yul bag chags bcom: thams cad lha sngags chos skur dag smin rdzogs: bde chen rdul bral zhing gi rol bar blta: o a mi dhe wa a lūḥsirnyi hūṃ trīḥ bzlas pa dbug ga rta la bskyod ting 'dzin ldan pas bye ba bzla las nyon bag chags sgribatshogs dag /nyams rtogs ye shes yon tan 'phel rtags dang mtshan ma khyad 'phags 'byung bden rdzun lag tu longs da gsal sa ma yu sgrub 'dzab ni trī bdag nyid sangs rgyas 'od snang mtha' yas kyi: sku

yi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas: 'od zer rang mdog lcags kyu'i rnam pa can grangs dang mu med 'khor 'das yongs khyab 'phros: sangs rgyas byang sems mkhyen brtse nusagasum dpal: bdag dang tshe 'das la thim sgo gsum gyi las nyon bag chags dri ma kun dag dmigs mar 'phros 'gro drug 'khor ba'i gnas stong nas: kun kyang bde ldanapad+mo bkod zhing du: dbug dbyung phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob dmigs: na mo ār+ya a mi rta bha hrī sarba pa paṃ dha ha na shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: smra 4da bzlas pa labyum phrag bdun gnad smin lasanyon bag chags sbyangs nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel 'gro don 'phrin las bsam yas 'byung sa ma yu las sbyor 'dzab dmigs na hū hrī snang ba bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa'i zhing sgra grags 'gags med gsung gsang chos kyi sgra: 'gyu 'phro mkhyen nus brtse ba'i ye shes ngang: gdul dka' nyon mongs 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyis 'khor ba dong sprugs mdzad pa mthar phyin dmigs: na mo rat+na dra yā yaḥ na mo bha ga wa te a mi ta bha ya: ta thā ga ta ya: arta te samyakle brnya ya: taduthā: 37 a mi te a mi to bha we a mi ta saṃ bha ya: a mi ta bī kusto

(1) a mi ta gā mi ni ga ga na kirti ka ri sarba kle sha k+ta ye ka ri swā hā: ting 'dzin ldan pas 'bum phrag bzla gnad des las nyon bag chags sbyangs 'brel tshad rgyud la phan thogs 'byung (1 17 zhing du the mi tshom sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la rnam grangs bco lnga'i sgo nas bstan sa ma yu dang po chogs rdzas byin rlabs ni hūṃ trīX brdal khyab stong chen yangs pa'i bhan+ta na sna tshogs 'gags med shar ba'i tshogs ston sprin zhi lhag rig pa'i rang mdangs me rlung chus: zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i mkha' khyab sprin: badz+ra pū dza spra ra ṇa sa: spyan 'dren ni hūṃ hrī nub phyogs bde chen dbang gi pho brang nas gsung mchog pad+ma rigs kyi gtso bo mchog snang ba mtha' yas yab yum sras 'khor bcas 'du ba tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol rnal 'byor chags nyams rtogs sgrib sbyangs ba dang: bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs par mdzod: snyen a misawa sarba sa ma yā dza dza: tshogasaphud ni oṃ us tshogs ston 'dod yon lnga yi sprin phung 'khrigs: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin che ba'i mchog 'dod yon lha mo'i dga' ston dang bcas te gsung mchog rgyal ba'i

gsang gsum bskang phyir 'bul tsho ma hā ga ṇa tsakra pū dza kha twe: bar bshags ni ho: ma rig gnyis 'dzin sems kyis dbang gyur te: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa dang:las nyon bag chags dri ma phra rags kun: thabs mchog tshogs kyi 'khor los bskang zhing bshags badz+ra sa ma mā āḥ tshogs bsgral ni hū dza: med la yod par 'dzin pa'i bdag rtog bsgral gnyis su snang ba'i zhen rtog rang sar gzhig chos nyid 'khrul mi shes par rgyas btab ste: gzugs phung dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo spel: sarba du tra pra we sha ya phaṭa: bstabs pa na hūṃ trī: chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i zhal bum du log rtog bsgral ba'i phung khams skye mched bstabs: gnyis med mnyam pa nyid du 'dren rol nas:'khrul ba rang zhig sku gsum mngon 'gyur mdzod me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la khā twe lhag ma ni phernyi chos nyid dag pa rdo rje'i gsang sgog can: ma sring ging ling dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs 'dir gshegs 'dod yon pham phab lhag gtor bzhes: rnam mang 'phrin las gang bcol thogs med sgrubs bde chen pad+ma 'od du stel ma mdzod: sa dang lam gyi 'phral rkyen

shā bar chad sol: ma mā sarba uṣ+ṭi ṭa bā ling ta kha hi: bskul ba ni hūṃ hrī: mi mngon chos dbyings dbus mtha' bral ba nas: bde gshegs kun dngos gsung 1 11nga phyug che: 'od snang mtha' yas sras 'khor sprul bar bcas: gdul dka' nyon mobhe sa rgyas pa'i sems can rnams 'khrul ba ru bzlog rnam grol sar 'god phyir ye shes sgyu mar rol ba'i phyag rgyar bzhengs: rkyen snang cer grol gtor ma 'di zhes la: nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i bdud bzhi tshar chod cig bdochen pad+ma 'od du lam sna drongs gnyer bcol 'brin las ma g.yel myur 'grub mdzod zhal bzhes thugs dam dus bab sa ma yā: lo tho ni hūṃ sto bdogashadagasakun 'dus gsung gi dbang phyug che: rdo rje pad+mathod pa'i 'phreng ba yis: bka' nyan bod skyong dregs pa rgya mtsho yis: rkyen snang rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gyis: phyi rkyen bdud bzhis 'tshe ba dbyings su sgrol: nang rkyen dug lnga'i rtog pa thad shar chod: gsang ba rlung sems kun rtogs rang sar gzhig gdul zhing bzang ngan las kyis 'brel tshad

kun 'og min pad+ma 'od du skyel ma mdzod las ngan 'khor ba'i 'dam mtsho skem pa dang: bde chen zhing spyod mdzad 'phrin rgyas par mdzod: bstan ma ni bya rdo rje slob dpon pad+ma thod 'phreng gis bka' nyan gangs ri'i yul skyong brtan ma ni: rdo rje kun grags gangs kyi g.yu bun dang: sman btsunasngagag chos mkha' lding la ro sman: rdo rje gragasargyal gong btsun de mo sogs: ma yum bcu gnyis g.yog 'khor dpung dang bcas ming posa'abod do ma g.yel da tshur byon: dam rdzas bshal chab tshogs gtor 'di bzhes la bsnyen sgrub ting 'dzin bsgom pa'i grogs mdzod cig 'tsho ba sbyor la rkyen gegs nyer 'tshe bzlog bde chen pad+ma 'od zhing mngon gyur nas: sprul pas 'khor ba'i 'dam mtsho skemagrogs mdzod: yo ma mā la wā haṃ hūṃ bā ling ta khā hi: rta bro ni stsa chosanyid stong pa chen po'i e klong du rnam rtogs gnyis snang dam sri brub pa la: dbang chen rol ba'i rta bro'i rgyayis gdab: 'khrul ba ka dag nang dbyings mngon 'gyur mdzod sarba ru tra dam sri sta bha ya nan: bshags pa ni ho ma rig rgyu gsum rkyen bzhis dbang gyur nong: bskyed rim ma

shā kyi gsal ting 'dzin bogs ma thon: mchod rdzas ma 'byor las nyon bag chags sgrib: mi 'chab gnong 'gyod sdom sems bcas te bshags: sa ma yu pha bsngo zlostu ho 'dus dang 'dus ma byas pa'i dge tshogs kun gcig bsdus 'khor gsum yongs dag chen por bsngo: ma rig 'khrul snang 'khor ba dong sprugs nas: bde chen pad+mo bkod par byang chub shog lan gsum bsdu ldang ni sa zhing khams gzhal yas lha rnams gtso bo la: de yang thugs sgog nā dwa spros bral ngang: slar yang gting gsal gnyug ma'i shes rig nyid bder gshegs gsung gi rdo rje'i phyag rgyar ldang: ā phaṭa: shis brjod ni na mo kun gzhi phra rags dbyings su nub pa las: 'khor 'das thams cad dwangs ma'i gshis su sad: ma brtsal rdzogs ldan bde chen bkod pa'i zhing ji bzhin klong gyur 'bras ba'i shis pa stsol: gnyis su med la yod par lta ba'i 'gro: 'khrul ba sems kyi 'chang rgya rang zhig nas: bya rtsol blo 'das dgongs pa'i btsan sa zin: sku gsum ye shes mngon gyur shis bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba'i skye 'gro rnams rgyu 'bras ngan pa'i

dbang du mi 'gro bar: bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing khams su: mi ldog rig 'dzin gral spyod shis pa stsol de ltar sbyor dngos rjes tshangs bas bde re zhing sgrub sus bsgom yang las nyon dri ma bag chags bcom tshe dang bsod nams nyamasartogs 'phel don gnyis lhun grub gdon mi za sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya me ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs bcud chos ma dang mkha' 'gro'i srog bcud 'di snyigs ma'i gdul bya skyobasapa'i phyor thugs sras rag 'dzin dpal du bzhag tshogasasmon las 'phrosabaskul ba'i tshe gdul bya' zhing sar gsal bar byas 'brel tshad bde ldan pad+ma 'od mngon 'gyur 'di la the mi tshom bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos srungs gdul bya'i zhing khamasayongs khyab mdzod sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu h+ye brda tham (6) zhesapa 'di yang tshogs smon lasa'aphros bskul ba gos ri dbon po o rgyan bstan 'dzan gyas bkra shis lta reg gu ru' snang brnyan sogs dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te nan tan chen pos bskul ngor 7 kho bo klong yang nam mkha'i rnal 'byor nu ldan 'dusapa rtsal gyis dbyings sna mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa na lu zin mi dris brgyas pa dge legs 'phel/ sarba maṅga lam/

r+shar+sha) tshogs la rol ba ni e ma ho: myong grol sngags kyi dga' ston tshogs: bde ba chen pos 'bar bzhus rdzas byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni: dga' bzhi'i rte1 gar bsgyur zhing rol: a ho ma hā su kha a la la ho: 'di yanganus ldan rdo rjes smras mi ger mi dris bkod pa dge sarba masgo lam ——1 bstod bsdus ni hūṃ hrī bde chen zhing gi mgon po 'od mtha' yas: tshe dang ye shes dpag med bcom ldan 'das: mthong thos dran reg rnam grol rgyal ba la:bdag g.yin khyed shes dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod: 'di yang o rgyan bstan 'dzan ngor nus ldan pa sa bris pa 'o

—13 dag snang las: bde gshegs 'od mtha' yas pa'i sgrub pa zab mo'i dgyes bskyed bskang ba pad+ma rā ga'i 'phreng mdzes bzhugs —13 na mo a mi dhe wa hrī: 43tsam145 dngos su 'byor dang yid sprul bas bskang rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa ra sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs bsgrur spel snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad do oṃ āX hūṃ trī: ka dag spros bral chos kyi dbyings nyid las: gdod ma'i sangs rgyas yab yum thugs dam bskang: 'od lnga ma 'dres bde chen klong yangs nas: longs sku rigs lnga yab yum thugs dam bskang: 'og min gsang ba mchog gi pho brang nas: sprul sku lag na rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang sems klong man ngag snying rje'i mdzod 'dzin pa: rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang: snying thig dgongs pas rig 'dzin 'ja' skur sbyor: rig 'dzin shrī seng ha'i thugs dam bskang: klong chen mtha' bral lta ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa mkhas pa dz+ra na su ta'i thags dam basmang: sde gnyis paṇa grab gro mtsho'i gtsug rban mchog rig 'dzin bi ma mi tra'i thugs dam basmang brdzas stes smal sma mi mjed

zhing gi mgon gu ru pad+ma rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang:lha mo dbyangs can mi yi zol 'dzin pa dgyes sde ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang:'jam dpal dbyangs dngos chos rgyal tshul 'dzin pa bod skyong khri'u srong lde'u btsan thugs dam bskang:byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa'i srol 'dzin pa:rgyal sras bo dhi sa twa'i thugs dam bskang lta dgongs rtogs pa phul byung lo tsa'i rje:mkhas pa be+e ro tsā na'i thugs dam bskang:sra brtan brag las 'chi med tshe chu bton:gnyag pa zla shar gzhon nu'i thugs dam bskang:dbang chen gsung rtag rta zhal gtsug na spa:ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs thugs dam bskang:nyi ma'i zer bcib dbyings phyug ḍāk+kir rol:gnub ban nam mkha'i snying po'i thugs dam bskang:sngags ston grub rtags sgrub pa'i brag la gdab gnub ston sangs rgyas ye shes thugs dam bskang 'brin las thogs med rlung ltar 'jug pa mnga':sngags pa rdo rje bdud 'joms thugs dam bskang:ma mo bran bkol lha srin rang dbang bsgyur:'brog mi dpal kyi ye shes thugs dam bskang chos dbyings klong yangs rig

7༷ pa'i nyi ma shar:nying ban ting 'dzin bzang bo'i thugs dam bskang dregs pa bran khol nus mthu'i gter grub pa:rlangs pa dpal kyi seng ge'i thugs dam (11:'bod rbad bsad pa'i dam tshig gnyer 'dzin pa:grong rigs sog po lha dpal thugs dam bskang:ye shes gzigs pas gdul bya'i skyabs mdzad pa:rje 'bangs lo paṇa rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang:bde ba mchog sbyin dam chos gter bskrun paḥthugs byon jo mo rnams lnga'i thugs dam bskang:snyigs ma'i skyabs su zab gter dpal sbyin pa:snyen rgyan rgyal tshab rnams kyi thugs dam bskang:dag snang dgongs pa sa gter lde mig 'dzin:rigs lnga'i rtags ldan gzung ma'i thugs dam bskang:bla ma'i bka' bsgrub zab gter drod 'dzin pa:gter slob chos bdag rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang:spyi bor bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan gcig pu:bka' drin gsum ldan bla ma'i thugs dam bskang hūṃ hrī nub phyogs bde chen pad+ma brtsegs pa nas:gsung mchog 'od snang mtha' yas thugs dam bskang grangs med gong nas zhal bzhes gdul bya'i mgon:'dren pa 'od mi

'gyur ba'i thugs dam bskang:zhing khams mchog bzung 'pho ba'i sgo 'byed pa:mgon po 'od dpag med pa'i thugs dam bskang:ma chags pad+ma rā ga'i zhal bzang can bdemachog bkod pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang:mkhyen nus brtse ba'i 'brin las nub med pa:mgon po thugs rje'i gter chen thugs dam bskang:bzang ngan las kyis 'brelaba'i skye bo rnams:tshad med stobs kyis sgrol mdzad thugs dam bskang tshe dang pe shesadapag med bcom ldan 'das:skye med gnyug ma'i don ston thugs dam bskang:'bumaphrag 'od zer bye brag bsam yas 'gyed:nyon mongs gcong rong skems mdzad thugs dam bskang:gang 'brel ngan song 'khor ba'i skye sgo kheg:tshad med 'dren stobs mnga'abartes thugs dam bskang:dpa' bo khyed bsnyen bdag sems dag pa yis:gang 'brel don dang ldan slad bskang bar bgyi hū hrī phyi mchod gzung ba dag pa'i nyer spyod bdun snang zhen dri ma ka nas dag phyir 'bul nang mchod 'dzin pa grol ba'i 'dod yon lnga nyer len a mtha' ma rig sangs phyir 'bul:rkyen ngan lam sgong phyag rgya bro dang gar

shā bdud bzhi lam slong chos rnams zad phyir 'bul: ngo mtshar bkra shis rdzas rtags rgyal srid bdun: lta sgom spyod pa mtha' ru phyin phyir 'bul: gsang mchod drordo khyen rdo rje rig ma'i tshogs: cha med kun 'gro'i chos nyid rtogs phyir 'bul dug lnga cer grol sbyor dang sgrol mchod sprin: sa lam mthar phyin 'bras bu thob phyir 'bul:rmad byung ga ṇa tsakra'i dga' ston dpal: rtsa ba yan lag chags nyams gso ba dang: bdag lus dge tshogs dus gsum rnam dkar dpal: 'brel tshad don ldan byang chub spyod par bgyi: las dang nyon mongs shes sgrib bag chags kun: rnam par dag nas bde ldan pad+mo bkod rgyal ba 'od mtshan stong 'bar zhabs drung du: mi 'bral tshom bu gcig tu 'a31gas par regag /de ltar bskang bas tshogs chen rdzo gas sgrib dag nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyas 'brel tshad bde chen zhing du 'god don gnyis lhun grub the mi tshom bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos srungs bskal bzang pad tshal bzhad mdzad la 'brel tshad rig 'dzan zhi du rkyol sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim (5) zhes pa 'di yang tshogs smon las 'phros bskul ba dbon po o rgyan bstan 'dzan nas bkra shisalta reg gu ru'i snang brnyan

bcas rgyud kyi bstan pa 'dzan pa'i dam bca' bcasate nan tan chen po sa bskul ngor 7 kho bo nu ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lu zin me dris bgyis pa dge legasa'aphel sarba masgo 'a ma

sgo tsho dag snang las: gnas dang yul gyi bskang ba na (: 'og min gnas dang mkha' spyod zhing: he ru'i gnas bcu dur khrod brgyad: nyi shu rtsa bzhi yul so gnyis: sa byerdo sprul ba'i gnas rnams nas: dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byer ma: mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dga' ston 'du ba chen por bskul: dam tshig la dgongs da tshur byon:brda glu rol mo'i sgra la gson: rnal 'byor nyams rtogs spel grogs mdzod: 'dod yon rgyan gyi tshogs la rol: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i tshogs la rol: dgyes shing dga' ba'i mdangs ston la: bde stong dga' bzhi'i nyams rtogs sbor: sgyu lus zhu bdes smin pa dang: rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i gral dbus skyol don gnyis lhun gyis grub mdzod cig /de ltar phul sa tshogs chen rdzogs nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel rgyas 'gyur sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya gu h+ya brda thim (3) zhes pa'ang tshogs smon las 'dzoms dbon po o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ro ra 7 kho bo nus ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyi sa sna mkha' 'gro'i bdo mdzod las bsgyur bas yi ge pa ni lung zin mi dris bgyas pa dge legs 'phe la sarba masgo lam

7༷ dag snang las:gter srung tsan+ti ka dmar mo'i bskang gsolaphan bde'i dpal ster bzhugs so:——ka na mo a mi ba rte hrīḥ zu bzas sa/ thugs mthun mchod rdzas yo byad bsags jags dang phyag rgyas spel byas te kye:rang mdun 'ja' sprin pad mo'i dga' tshal 'khrigs:cang shes glang po rma byas rtse gar bsgyur:nor sna 'dod yon ljon shing ra bas bskor:mtsho rdzing lding ga ne'u gseng mdzes bzhad dbus:rat+na lnga yi gzhal med khang mdzes nang:chags bral pad ma 'dab stong zla ba'i khar:dbang gi lha mo bde sbyin tsarnyi ga:dmar mo gcer bu zhi 'dzum chags sgeg 'bar pad 'phreng nor bu'i do shal dar dpyang spras:nu 'bur pad mo 'bus shing dga' bzhi ster:phyag g.yas pad+ma'i lcags kyus 'gro blo 'gugs:g.yon pa gter bum 'dod dgu'i char rgyun 'bebs rasgo'i dbu rgyan rtse phran dar sna'i 'phan:zhabs gnyis 'dor stabs 'ja' lnga'i gur khang 'khrigs bde dang stong pa'i gzi byin mchog tu 'bar phyag brnyan lha mo brgyad kyis 'dod yon

spro: kun kyang gsangaba'i dam tshig mchog la gus: srog gis bskul te mkha' spyod gling dbus nas ye shes pa rnams sbyan drangs dbyer med bsre: spyan 'dren ni hūhrī: mkha' spyod dga' ma'i 'bum sprin 'khyil dbus nas: bde sbyin dbang gi lha mo tsarnyi ka phyag brnyan brgyad dang sprul pa g.yog 'khor bcas: gus gdung bu yis 'bod do da tshur byon:'dzum pa'i zhal ngom dkyus ring spyan gyis gzigs bde ba'i 'o chu'i gter g.yos rlung gis bsil mos ldan bdag reg sgyu lus zag pa zad: dwangs ma'i 'od phung 'byung bar mdzad du gsol: ma pad+ma ḍak+ki ni tsarnyi ka sa ma yā pho phe bzhugs gsol ni trī ting 'dzin las 'khrungs gzhal med 'od re gsal: bde stong kha sbyor pad zla mdangs dang ldan 'ja' lnga'i 'od khyim gdos bral bag re bro: de la mkha' 'gro dgyes pa mchog gis bzhugs: sa ma yā stu phyag 'tshal ni na mo nyon mongs las kyi dug chus mi gdung bar:bde ba mchog snyoms bdud rtsi chus bstsal nas: bdag je'i 'dab stong ge sar rab rgyas te sgyu lus 'od phung 'byung phyir brda phyag 'tshal: sa ma yu na mo a la la ho: gsol

mi kyi mchod ni kye mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rje tsin+t+ra ga: bde ba mchog la rol bzhin nye bar dgongs: thugs mthun mchod sprin ting 'dzin las 'khrungasabaskodro: mkha' dbyings dogs mor byed pa'i dga' ston 'bul: gnyisamed mnyam pa chen por rab bzhes la: brtse gdung lhod med rtag par bdag grogs mdzod: dga' ba'izla zhal lha mo'i me yis bskul: khams drug dwangs ma rdo rje gsum du smin:sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur dbyings la rol ba'i tshe mkha' spyod gling du sun ma mdzad du gsol: can pad+ma ḍa k+ki ni tsan+t+ra ka sarba sa pā ri wa ra e de bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: pañca a sri ta khā hi: bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī mkha' dbyingasabu mo rta bdun mdangs 'dzin ma: dran pas ma rig munakhams rab sangs shing: bde stong 'bar ba'i gzi byin mchog bskyed pa'i: pad+ma'i rigs grub lha mo khyod la bstod:tsho rabs kun tu thugs rjes ma dor skyongs: rnam mkhyen byangachub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /'phrin bcol ni kye thugs bskyod med byung byang chub sems ldan pas: bka' 'khor dam tshag la gnas dregs pa'i tshogs: gsol lo mchod do

bskang ngo mnga' gsol bstod: rnam mang 'brin las rab 'byams char ltar rnyil: rgya 'dre smon log dam sri 'byung po'i tshogs: mi mthun 'gal zla ston pa'i bdud rigs dang dgra 'dre gyod phur kha smras gleng mo sogs nyes pa'i phyogs kun zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod tshe dpal bsod nams snyan grags sde bzhi'i dpal: zas nor longs spyod 'dodargu'i phywa dang g.yang: legs pa'i yon tan bkra shis dge ba'i phyogs: nam yang mi nub dar zhing rgyas par mdzod lha 'dre mi gsum mosapa rnam bzhi'i sde: bde stong 'bar ba'i'od gsol dga' ba bzhi: 'gyur med bde chen nam mkha'i rdo rje che: ma lus dbang du bsgyur ba'i 'phrin las stsol nyon mongs lagaskyesam rig gsum gyi dgra: rten 'breladabang gyur log rtogs bdud bzhi'i sde: 'gro drug g.yang sa sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las ma lus bsgral zhing 'dren par mdzad du gsol tshe gang bsam don dkar po'i chosa'agrub cing: nag phyogs gdug pa'i dbang du mi 'gyur bar sa lam nyams rtogs rtsal chen rab rdzogs te: mkha' spyod mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rjer 'gyur bar mdzod gnyer

tre ༷ bcol 'phrin las ma g.yel sa ma yu:lags pa na ho rgyal bslabastan skyong bka' sdod rgya mtshos dgongs:bdag rmongs 'khrul bas dbang gyur mi dge'i(11gang yang mi 'chab gnong 'gyod sems kyis bshags:bzod gsol tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsolasnyebadz+ra sam mā a:de ra dbang gelha mo yi gsol mchod thabs la susabartson kyang mi mthun dgra gdon g.yul las rgyal tshe bsod nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel dan gnye lhun grub gdon mi za sa ma pā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thim po'i zhesapa 'di yang lung zin yo rgyan bstan 'dzan nas bkrashas dge ba'i skyes bcas nan tan chen pos bskul ngor 7kho bo nu ldan 'dus pa rtsal gyis dbyings snang mkha' 'gros brda mdzod las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam
dpa dag snang ye shes rol pa las:gshin po gnas ngan las drangs shingabadochen zhing du bkod pa'i thabs rnam grol lam bzang zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

shā 'i na mo a midhe wa hrī mi casazatha14 byang chub themasadangaldan pa yi theg go lam zhugs rig 'dzin gyis gdul bya yal bar mi 'dor bar gnas sbyong cho gas 'dren par brtson ( 1 1 bdag mdun bum bzlosatshogs bsags dang rag pa'i me tog dor ba' rjes ming byang bskyed chog 'ad lta ste byams dang snying rje'i ngang ldan pas hū hrī: nga ni 'gro kun 'dren mdzad thugs rje can mkhyen nus brtse ba'i gter chen snang mtha' yas 'gro drug sems can gcig kyang ma lus par: mdun du gsal btab 'dren pa'i thabs la 'bad: 31 a mi dhe wa hrī: hrī mdun gyi rten snangastong pa'i ngang nyid las: j-isapas tshe 'das phung khams skye mched kun: gson gyi gnas skabs ji bzhin gsal bar bskyed dmigs yul rnam shes gar yod sa nas bstim: bden brjod ni na mo skyabazlo gnas kun 'dus mgon po 'od dpag med: snying rje'i rang gzugs phyag na pad dkar 'chang: nus mthu'i gter 'dzin mthu chen sgob dbang phyug /nye sras brang sems 'phags pa'i bden stobs kyis dmigs yul rnam shes khams gsum gar gnas kyang: rang dbang med par ming byang 'di la khug

shā /sbyobadz+ra e gu sha ya dza dza: lan bdun nam dgu brjod dbyer med du bcang ba ni hrī 'disnang las thal tshe 'das pho mo nyon: rigs drug gar skyes sdug bsngalarge(rmi gyi gzeb: de las 'don phyir gzugs ming yid chags rdzas: sgo gsum rten rdzas 'di dang gnyis med gyur: dzasgropaṃho: chang glud bsngo ba ni ram̐ yam̐ kho dreḥlas rin po cheyi snod dutsan las glud gtor 'dod don lnga ldan gyi phung po zad mi shes pa 'i gter du gyur: tshes/ debs gshag pa bzhi'i marga bo da saṃ bha ra'i sngags kyis spel mthar bla sarba 81 na maXsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo sogs khaṃ ṣ+ṭṛsto rda bā la ya ti swā hā: lan gsum gyis zha bar sbyangs oṃ sum bha ni sum bha ni hūṃ sogs hūṃ phaṭa: lan gsum gyis phyed mar sbyangs hūṃ hrī: las dang nye mongs bag chags kyis bskyed pa'i dbugs len gshin du brdzu ba'i 'byung po rnams: lan chags glud kyi mchod bzhin 'di khyer la: thar lam ma 'gogs gzhan du phyiradengs shig /bden brjod byas la thun gyi brab des ni drag por sbyangs ba'o hūṃ che stong 'og phyogs mtshams mtshon cha sna lnga'i gur ye shes me chu rlung gi rwa gur dkrigs: rjes chags bshad

pa'i khro rdul bu yug 'tshub: 'di la gnyis 'dzin 'byung po nye mi nus: dz+nyā na dhartu rak+ta rak+ṣa sbyo: bag mags bsregs pa ni hū hrī ma rig 'khor bar 'phen pa'i las nyon sgrib rigasadrug sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid stong par bsregaḥ khams gsum sgo gsum dug gsum ming med gyur: e sarba pā pe da ha na.aḥn+niḥsumaXtriX preḥduX dz+wa la ram̐ sarba bha smi ku ru ye swā hā: lan bdun gyis bsreg sbyangs byed bden pa' skyabs sbyin pa na: na mo skyabs gnas kun 'das mgon po 'od dpag med: sras dngabacas pa mgon med 'gro la dgongs: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho lasaḥ bsgral nas thar ba'i lam la drangs tu gsol: lan gsum ngo sprod bya ba ni hū hṝ snang ste nga dbyer med chos kyi dbyings nyid las: glo bur rlung sems phra bas sgrib skyon gyis nga bdag yul gsum tha snyad gzungs 'dzin bskyed: ma rig dbang gis rten 'brel bcu gnyis srid: 'dor ba'i 'khor lo rten 'brel grong khyer rgyan 'di phyi bar gsum snang ba phra rag kun: med bzhin snang ba kun byed mkhan pos 'phrul: bdag tu 'dzin pas

/rdo 'khor las 'khor bar 'ching:sgyu ma gzugs brnyan chu zla chu sbu dang:rmi lam smig sgyu dri za'i grong khyer dad :brag cha mig yol sprul ba ji bzhin du:stong pabyed 'byung bden med shes par gyis:'jig rten bya btang byar med nga la zhogajo yid las 'das kun gsal kun rig 'di:don gyi ye shes yin no shes par gyis:lasadang rnam smin rnam rtog rgya grol na:chos sku'i dgongs pa mi ring rang gsal rnyed:khams gsum ming med srid gsum ka dag klong:don gyi sangs rgyas mablal lo skal ba can dmyal ba'i gnas yul bkod pa ni skad cig snang ba gnas gyur rten 'brel du:tsha grangs nyi tshe nye 'khor dmyal ba'i gnas:rten dang brten pa mkha' la 'asnga' shar bzhin:dmigasayul rnam smin myong 'gyur sbyang phyir bkod:tshogs bsags ni hūṃ hrī nga ne+e 'gro kun 'dren mdzad 'od mtha' yas 'khor ba dong sprugs thugs kyis dam bcas pa'i:'phrin lasami nub chos kyi rgyal por sprul:dmigs yul tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir mchod tshogs bzhes:tsha grangs dmyal ba'i sdug bajal skyobs tu gsol:yin badz+ra na witre āX hūṃ:bum

dbang bskur ba ni hū hrī bum pa gsal dag 'od kyi gzhal med dbus: bcud ni me long ye shes bdud rtsi 'khyil: dmigs yul rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas nyon mongs zhesdang 'khrul rtogs dag gyur cig ston badz+ra kwa ya a bhi khiñca hūṃ lan chagasa'ajal ba ni hū 'ded den lnga ldan glud kyi gtor ma 'di: tshe 'das zhe sdang lan chags sbyangs ba'i phyir thar lam bar char gegs byed yongs la bajo: glud 'di bzhes la bu lon sod gyur cig /sarba bhu ta bā ling ta khā hi: khrus bya ba ni hū 'de ni pha rol phyin mchog bzod pa'i chu nyon mongs khong khro'i sdug ba la skyobs byed pa'i: skal ldan dmigs yul khyod la dbang bskur bas: nā ra ka yi sdug bsngal bral brar sgo ga /sarba pā paṃ dwa ha na shirnye ku ru ye swāhā: bag chags bsregs pa ni hrī bdag nyid lhar gsal rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer ye shes me yi rang bzhin 'phros: dmyal ba'i sa bon du dang bag chags bcas rangabazhin med pa'i chos nyid dag par bsregs: sasarba pā paṃ dz+wa la ram̐ sa mtshams bgo ba ni hā: sa 'de man chad na raka dmyal ba'i gnas: bzod med sdug bajal rgya mtsho gting

shā zi zab las thar phyir lha dang ja mar gsol ba thob dag pa'i zhing khams yid kyi 'dun pas zungs: yi dwags kyi gnas yul bkod pa ni skad cig snang ba gnas rgyedro rten 'brel du: bkres skom sdug bsngal yi dwags yul gyi gnas rten dang brten pa me long gzugs brnyan bzhin: tshe 'das rnam smin myong 'gyur sbyangs phyir bkod tshogs bsags ni hūṃ hrī nga ni 'gro kun 'dren mdzad 'od mtha' yas 'khor ba dongs sprugs zhal bzhes mthu btsan pa'i: 'phrin las mi nub kha 'bar dhe war sprul: tshe 'das tshogasaganyis rdzogs phyir mchod gtor bzhes yi dwags bkres skom sdug bsngal bsal du gsol: slo badz+ra nai wibye yis〉: bum dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ trī bum pa lhun grub rang byung gzhal med dbus: bcud ni sor rtogs ye shes bdud rtsi 'byil: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs 'dod chags gdung ba zhi gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñca snya lan chags 'jal ba ni hūṃ 'dod yon lnga ldan glad kyi gtor ma 'di tshe 'das 'dod chags lan chags sbang ba'i phyir: thar lam bar chad gegs byed yongs la bajo tshod

'di bzhes la bu lon sod gyur cig: sarba bhu ta bha ling ta khā hi: khrus bya ba ni hū: 'di ni phra mol phyin mchog sbyin pa'i chu: nyon mongs 'dod chags sdug bajal skyobs byed pa'i:skal ldan dmigs yul khyedad la dbang bskur bas: sre ta ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar 31ga /sarba pā paṃ dā ha na shirnyi ku dzag ye swā hā: bag chags bsregs pa ni hrī bdag nyid lhar gsal rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer ye shes me yi rang bzhin 'phros yi dwags sa bon pre dang bag chags bcas: rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid dag par bsregs:preḥsarba pā paṃ dz+wa la ram̐: sa mtshams bgo ba ni hū: sa 'di man chad sre ta yi dwags gnas bzod med bkres skom sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las thar phyir lha dang ja mar gsol ba thob:dag pa'i zhing khams yid kyi 'dun pas zungs: dud 'gra'i gnas yul bkod pa na skad cig snang ba gnas gyur rten 'brel du: bying gnas kha 'thor la sogs dud 'gro'i gnas: rten dang brten pa chu nang zla gzugs bzhin dmigs yul rnam smin myong 'byur sbyang phyir bkod: tshogs bsags na hūṃ hrī nga ni 'gro kun 'dren mdzad 'od mtha' yas: 'khorab

shā dongs sprugs zhal bzhes mthu btsan pa'i:'phrin las mi nub seng ge rab brtan sprul:tshe 'das tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir mchod tshogs bzhes:dud 'gro(1 1nga sdug bsngal bskyab tu gsol:tshe badz+ra nai wibye āḥ(:bum dab bskur ba na hūṃ gri bum pa rang byung gzhal med khaja mdzes nangaḥbacud ni chos dbyi sa ye shes bdud rtsi tshe 'das rigs kyi nyon mongs gti mug sdug bsngal oṃ badz+ra tsit+ta a sti ṣiñca sa lan chags 'jal ba na zwa 'dod yon lnga ldan glud kyi gtor ma 'di tshe 'das gti mug lan chags sbyangs thar lam bar chad gegs byed yongs la bsngo:glud 'ad bzhes la thar lam thob gyur cig/sarba bhu ta bā ling ta khā nyi:khrus bya ba ni sa 'di ni pha rol phyin mchog shes rab chu nyon mongs gti mug sdug bsngal skyobs byed pa':tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas/ti6 ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shogasarba pā paṃ da na shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā:bag chags bsregs pa ni hrīḥbadag nyid lhar gsal rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas:'od zer ye shes me ya rang bzhin spros:dud 'gro'i sa bon triḥdang bag chags bcas:rang

bzhin dag pa'i chos nyid chen por bsregs: tri sarba pā paṃ dz+wa la ram̐ sa mtshams bgo ba ni (ཿ sa'adi man chad twet+ya ka yi gnas: sdug bsngal rgya che bkol spyod gcong rong las thar phyir lha dang bla mar gsol ba thob dag pa'i zhing khams yid kyi 'dun pas zungs lta min gyi gnas yul bkod pa ni skad cig snang ba gnas gyur rten 'brel du ri rab zomabarten lha ma yin gyi gnas rten dang brten pa sgyu ma'i 'phrul bsgyur bzhin: tshe 'das rnam smin myong 'gyur sbyangs phyir bkod: tshogs bsags ni hūṃ hrī nga ni 'gro kun 'dren mdzada'od mtha' yas: 'khor ba dong sprugs zhal bzhes mthun btsan pas: 'phrin las mi nub thag bzang ris mchog sprul: tshe 'das tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir mchod gtor bzhes lha min 'thab rtsod 'jigs las bskyab tu gsol: 01 badz+ra nai wibye ā /: bum dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ hrīḥ bum pa mnyam brdal lhun grub gzhal med khang bcud ni bya grub ye shesabadud rtsi 'khyil: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la nyon mongs phrag dog sdug bajal zhi gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra sarba a bhi— nyu: lan chags 'jal ba ni hūṃ 'dod ye na lnga ldan glud kyi tshe

shā 4 'das phrag dog lan chags sbyangs ba'i phyir: thar lam bar chad glud 'di bzhes la sarba bhu ta steng ta khā hi: khrus bya ba ni hūṃ 'di ni pha rol phyin mchog(tā drums chu: nyon mongs phrag dog sdug bajal skyobs byed pa'i: skal ldan dmigs yul he sa ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shog sarba pā paṃ da ha na shirnye ku ru ye swā hā: bgachags bsregs pa ni hrīḥ bdag nyid lhar 'od zer ye shes lha min sa bon su dang bag chags bcas: rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid su sarba pā paṃ dz+wa la ram̐ sa mtshams brgo ba na hūṃ sa 'di man chad 'thab rtsod lha min gnas sdug bajal rgya che 'thab rtsod gnas ris las: thar phyir lha dang ja mar dag pa'i zhing khams yid kyi 'dun pas zungs: lha yiganas yul bkod pa ni skad cig snang ba gnas 'gyur rten 'brel du: 'chi 'pho lhung byed 'dod khams lha yi gnas: rten dang brten pa me long gzugs brnyan bzhin: dmigs yularnam tshogs bsags na hūṃ hrī nga ni 'gro kun 'khor ba dong sprugs 'phrin las mi nub lha dbang brgya byin sprul: dmigs yul tshogs 'chi 'pho lhung byed sdug bsngal

sbyang du gsol: tshe badz+ra ni witre āḥhūṃ: bum dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ hrī bum pa rang byung lhun grub gzhal med khang bcud ni mnyam nyid ye shes tshe 'das rigs kyi nyon mongs nga rgyal 'khrul rtogs dag gyur cig: rgo badz+ra sirnyi a bhi ṣañci nyu lan chags 'jal ba ni 'dod yon lnga ldan glud kyi tshe 'das nga rgyal lan chags: thar lam bar chad glud 'di bzhes la bu lon sod gyur cig /sarba bhu ta bhing ta khā hi: khrus bya ba ni sa 'di ni pha rol byin mchog bsam bstan chu: nyon mongs nga rgyal sdug bsngal skal ldan dmigs yul 'chi 'pho ltung ba'i sdug bsngal sbyang du gsol: sarba pā paṃ da ha na shidz+nya ku ru ye swā hā bag chags bsregs pa mi hrī bdag nyid lhar gsal rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer ye shes me yi rang bzhin spros lha yi sa bon aḥdang bag chags bcas rang bzhin med pa'i chos nyid dag par bsregs: aḥsarba pā paṃ dz+wa la ram̐: sa mtshams bgo ba na hūṃ sa 'di man chad 'dod khams lha yi gnas sdug bsngal rgya chen 'chi 'pho lhung byed las: thar phyir lha dang bla mar gsol ba thob: dag pa'i zhing khams yid kyi 'dun pas zungs: mi yi

r+shardor+sha gnas yul bkod pa ni skad cig snang ba gnas gyur rten 'brel du: gling bzhi gling phran 'jig rten mi yi gnas: rten dang brten pa chu nang zla gzugs ltar: tshe /de rnam smin myong 'gyur sbyangs phyir bkod: tshogs bsags ni hūṃ hrīḥ nga ni 'gro kun 'dren mdzad 'od mtha' yas: 'khor ba dong sprugs zhal bzhes mthu btsan pas: 'phrin las mi nub shākya seng ger sprul: tshe 'das tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir mchod gtor bzhes: skye sga na 'chi'i sdug bsngal bsal du gsol: tshe badz+ra ni wibye ā /: bum dbang bskur ban hūṃ hrī: bum pa rang byung mnyam brdal gzhal med dbus bcud ni ye shes lnga ldan bdud rtsi 'khyil: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la dbang nyon mongs dug lnga'i gdung ba zhi gyur cig ( bud+dha badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garmā a bhi gas sa: lan chags 'jam ba na hūṃ 'dod yon lnga ldan glud kyi gtor ma 'ad tshe 'das 'khrul snang sdug bsngal sbyangs ba dang: thar lam bar chad gegs byed yongs la bsngoḥ ngom shing tshim nas zhen 'dzin grol bar shog /sarba byu ta bha ling ta khā hi: khrus bya ba ni hūṃ 'dini pha rol phyin mchog brtson 'grus chu: nyon

mongs dug lngas gdung ba zhi byed pa'i: tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la the tshom log lta'i dri ma dag gyur cig /sarba pā paṃ da ha na shidz+nya ku ru ye swā hā: bag chags bsregs pa ni hrī bdag nyid lhar gsal rgyal ba'i thugs ka nas: 'od zer ye shes me yi rang bzhin spros: mi yi sa bon hṝḥdang bag chags bcas: chos nyid rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings su bsregs d+dhiḥsarba pā paṃ dz+wa la ram̐: sa mtshams bgo ba na (ཿ sa 'di man chad rigs drug 'khor ba'i klong: sdug bsngal gsum gyis rgya che rgyun ring mnar: gnas ngan de ru zhen chags mi byedapar: sa 'di yan chad bde chen thar ba'i lam: dag pa'i zhing khams yid kyi 'dun pas zungs: chags sdang sbongs la bla ma yab yum sgoms: bu khyod 'khor ba'i gnas 'diram 'dug par: bde chen dag pa'i zhing du 'gro bar gyis gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i dbang la zhugs: sdom dang dam tshig srog gi gta' ru 'dzin: smin zhing grol nas rig 'dzin sa 'thob 'gyur: maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni e ma: bla ma mgon po 'od dpag med pa dgongs: bdag ni 'khor ba'i gnas las dbug dbyung zhing : bde chen thar ba'i

za ༷ lam mchog bstan pa'i phyir:smin byed dbang gi dngos grub gnang du gsol lan gsum bla mas yinam bdag gis thar ba'i lam mchog bstan lags na byedro1 srog sdom pa dam tshig rim pa rnams:khyed cag rjes su zhugs nas 'dzin lags sam:yongs su bsrung na thar lam dbang mchog bstan:sdom bzungasani cagam bdechen zheng gi ston pa 'od mtha' yas:kun bzang zhi khro bla ma yab yum la 'di bzungs byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi bla med mchog gi sems bskyed sdom la gnas:rdo rje'i dmatshig byang chub sems yang 'dzin rin chen dam tshig sbyin pa rnam bzhir brtson pad+ma'i dam tshig theg gsum chos rnams bshad las rab dam tshig 'gro ba'i don la brtson bder gshegs dam tshig dag mnyam lam du khyer:rtsa ba yan lag sdom la gnas par bya bdag lus rdul snyed grangs sprul gus phyag 'tshal:dngos 'byor yid sprul phyi nangagasang mchod 'bul:thogs med nas bsags las nyon sdig sgrib bshags:mdzad pa rnam thar rgya mtshor rjes yi rang sangs rgyas byang sems mya ngan 'da' med bzhugs

phan bde'i 'byung gnas chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: dus gsum dge bsags gcig bsdus 'gro la bsngo: phyam gcig bde chen zhing gi sa thob re ga: heḥ lha dang sgob dpon thugs rje brtse bas dgongs: bdag gis rgyud sbyang sdom la gnas lags na: thugs rje brtse bas rjes su 'dzin pa dang: bde chen lam ston zhing dbang bskur du gsol lan gsum dam chu sbyin pa ni ho: bla rmed theg pa mchog gi sgor zhugs nas: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam srung ba dang : rtsa ba yan lag srog gtar 'chang ba'i phyir gsang ba'i mna' bor rdo rje'i dam chu 'thung: badz+ra sa ma ya na ra gan oṃ tsak+ṣu bhan+ta wa ra ma ṇa ye swā hā: zhes mag dar bkab a kha we ra (ཿ zhes me tog sbyin 6sgo ma hā shu n+yarte sogs ko3 haṃ skad cig gis slob ma de nyid sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas sku mdog dmar gsal pad+ma rā ga'i lhun po la nyin byed 'bum gyis 'byud pa'i gzi brjid can: mtshad bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus spras pa: chos gos rnam gsum sku la gsol zhing zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa: phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag

'o/ gi steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis bkang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa: sku g.yo med ri rgyal bzhin du bzhugs shing 'od dang 'od zer mtha' yas(1 11phro ba:g.yas su byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar gsal phyag g.yon pad+ma 'dab brgyad shel 'phreng gi mtshan pa 'dzin pa: g.yon du byang chubasems dpa' mthu chen thob sku mdog sngon po phyag g.yon rdo rje'i mtshan pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa: g.yas gnyis skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa: gnyis ka bzheja sa stabs kyisabazhugs shing longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyis spras par gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od dang 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros te nub phyogs bde ldan pad+mo bkod pa nasasangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas zhabor nye sras bya sems rgya mtshos bskor ba spyan drangs te khyed rang rnams la sib sib thim pa'i mos pa mdzod spos bsregasasnyan pa 'idabyangs da bcas hūṃ hrīḥnub phyogs bdeldan pad+mo bkod pa nas: gsung gi dbang phyug 'od snang mtha' yas mchog 'gro ba sems can don du spyan 'dren na: gdul bya rjes su 'dzin phyir

gshegs su gsol: o a mi dhe was yuḥsidhi dz+nyā na mu tra sa ma yā a we sha ya po po : zhes ye shes dbab phebasapa'i ye shes pa de nyid brtan par gyur cig tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra brda sgo dbye ba na hūṃ dkyil 'khor chen po phyogs bzhi'i sgo: nyon mongasasgrib pas bcad lags na tshad med rnam bzhi'i phyag rgyas phyes: ye shes bzhi yis zhal mthong mdzod: dz+nyā na pra we sha ya phaṭa: me tog 'bul ba ni hūṃ slob ma'i rig pa'i me tog 'di: bder gshegs gsung gi dal du 'bul: sngon nas las 'brel gang yod pa'i: lhag pa'i lha des bzhes su gsol:oṃ puṣe pra tits+tsha ho mig dar bsal ba ni ho: ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis: 'asdig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar khyed kyi ma rig 'dong ba'i mig ye shes spyan du dbye babyid doḥ.oṃ dz+nyā na tsak+ta pra we sha ya phaṭa mthong ba bstan pa ni kye ho: lasadang skal ba ldan pa rnams: dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos sdig sgrib nyon mongs bag chags 'dag /mi ring myur bar sangs rgyas 'grub: de phyir dga' dang spro bzhin pas: gsang ba rgyad la 'jug par 'tshal: o a mi dhe wa hri: bum dbang bskur ba ni hūṃ hri: stong gsal bde ba chen po'i

'o/ bum pa ru bum chu ye shes lnga yi bcud kyis gtams: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: lus ngag yid kyi 'dzin zhen rnam dag nas: snang stong(1 1sngug lha dbang thob par shog /oṃ a mi dhe wa hrīḥ kā ya a bhi gnyi tshe: gsung gsang ba'i dbang ni hūṃ gi banaskyong bhasto ka pā la yi nang: bla ma yab yum sbyor ba'i bcud kyisagatams: skal ldan rigs kyi bu la dbang bskur bas: rtsa rlung thig le'i zhen 'dzin rnam dag nas: gsal stong zung 'jug rtogs pa 'bar gyur cig sang a midhe wa hrī: wak+ka.a bhi ṣiñca ā: thugs ga dbang ni hūṃ sgi stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa 'od kyi sku: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum zhal: g.yin na med de rang gi byang chub sems da lta'i shes rig ma 'gags sa le ba: 'di don rtogs na srid pa tha ma yin: rgyal thabs spyi blug rig pa rtsal gyi dbang: thugs yid dbyer med 'dres pa'i dbang thob shog ltas a yispyowa hriḥ tsatā a sdi 〉〉 hūṃ dbang srag dam tshig khas blangs zhing yon 'bul mtha' rten shis brjod bya de nasa'ado yon bsngo ba ni sngags dang phyag rgyasaspel byas te snyen ātshwa: mdzas dzagang khod stsoms

rin chen gzhong pa na bza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i bye brag ni:lha klu mi yi dga' ston yid 'ong rnams ting 'dzin rig pas dbang bsgyur 'di na dgod rab gsal mig la bdud rtsi sbyin byed pa'i mdzes sdug gzugs kyi bye brag ci mchis dang:kun thos rna ba'i dbang po tshim byed pa'i sgra snyan grags stong rol mo'i bye brag dang:dri 'dzin shes ngor snang ba'i dga' ston dpal:tsan dan a gar seng ha bdug spos rigs ro yi dbang por bkod 'os dpal 'byor sprin:lha yi zhal zas pañca a mṛta reg shes dbang po skong byed 'dod pa'i yas:mdzes 'asngam yang srab bde ba bskyed pa'i gos khyon yangs nam mkha' dog mor byed pa yi lha rdzas 'dod yon lnga yi dga' ston dpal 'asdig rten las 'das tshe 'das khyod la bsngo zhen 'dzin sems kyi 'khrul bas ma bcing bar kun shes kun gsal rtogs pa'i rgyan du rol:khyod lus 'byung ba las byung rdul phran dengs:'byung ba lnga la bdag 'dzin mi byed par:dug lnga rang grol chos nyid ngang la zhog/rnam par mi rtog mthong na grol thob 'gyur:khyod la sgo lnga yul lnga rang mtshan med:

'o/ 'dod yon lnga la zhen 'dzin mi byed par: rkyen snang cer grol sgyu mar ngo shes nas: pha rol phyin mchog spyod la stobs ma zhan: 'di nas nub phyogs bde 5)ba sgong khams na: mgon po 'od dpag med pa bzhugs yod pas: khyod kyis 'dun pa zhing khams de ru gtod: me tog pakhro'i sbubs na bde skyid ldan: byang chub sems dpa' sems ma grogs re bzang stong nyid chos kyis rang sgra 'gags pa med: sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan kun gyis spyod: 'khor bar mi ldog srid las rnam par grol dga' dang spro bas zhing der 'gro bar rigs: gnyen bshes mdza' grogs nor dang longs spyod kun: mi rtag mi brtan sgyu ma rmi lam 'dra khyod rang bslus baglus da ni ma chags par: zag med nam mkha' mdzod 'di longs spyod la: bde chen dag pa'i zhing la 'gro bar gyis: a li u li ta li haṃ bha li bha ti ya ti swā hā zhing sbyang na ho 'di nas nub phyogs grangasamed dpag pa na bde ba can gyi zhing khams zhes bya yod: ma dag 'byung ba'i khams rnams mi dmigs kyang: shes rab srog tu shar ba'i 'byung lnga yod de yi snying rje ye shes

'od lnga'i dal:de la bsten nas rigs kyi bu khyod kyang:'od lnga 'dzin med rang shar rang grol rtogs:bde brtsegs pad+mo bkod zhing spyod gyur cig/'dod gsol ni ku ma rig gsum gyibasamanar ba'i yul khams 'dir:thogs med dus nas da la thugs bar mnar rgyal ba thugs rje can khyed ma gzigs sam:mgon med bdag gi lam sna 'dren pa dang :skyabs dang skyel ma dpung grogs mdzad byas nas 'khor ba 'di ru yid tsam mi gnas par bde chen pad+ma 'od du lam sna drongs:mar me'i smon lam ni kye ho sgog ma med nas ma rig rmong dbang gis ye shes gsal ba'i 'od lam bstan na'ang:mi shes ma rig rlung sems mun 'thub na ye shes sgron me'i 'od 'dis bsal byas nas:mar me gcig brten smon lam mtshams sbyar mthus: gegs bdud med par rig 'dzin gral zin nas:tshad med dad dang dag snang gis zhugs te:ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med 'grub par shog/gnas spar ni ye stong nyid dbu ma 'od kyi lam zhugs nas:rnam shes mgron po 'od lnga'i thig le de:rlung sems log rtogs 'khrul bas mi bsgyur bar:

mcho bla ma yab yum thugs rje byin rlabs dang mthong thos dran reg rnam grol mgon po de'i: thugs bskyed smon lam ra mda' sbran pa'i mthus skad cig nyid ( dīr+shag chen mda' 'phang ltar: mgon po 'od dpag med pa'i thugs gar 'phos: rgyal sras byang chub sems dpar dbang bskur nas mgon po de yi zhabs 'brang byed pa dang: ma sdo/sa 'a11 ba 'dren pa'i mthu ldan regag a phaṭa: zhes zhing khams sbyang sa a phaṭa zhes thugs yid bsre a phaṭa: zhes sras byang chub sems dpa' sad par bsam ming byang bsregs pa ni hūṃ hri stong gsal zung 'jug thig le'i skong bu rtsa tshad med rnam bzhi'i rang bzhin zhun mar gtams: rin chen byang chub sems kyi sdong bu btsug shes rab gsal ba'i sgron me rab sbar te: tshe 'das phung khams nyon shes dri ma kun: ye nas dag pa chos nyid dbyings su bsregs: ma a mi dhe wa hrī: aḥzloḥsu nyisreḥdu sarba pā paṃ da ha na dz+wa la ram̐ shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā: de ltar bde chen zhing sgrub la brten te ga na chog 'ad byas pas rang gzhan lasanyon sdig sgrob dag sa dang lam la 'byor bar 'gyur bka' 'di dam can rgya mtshos srungs thugs sras rig 'dzan dpal du sprod sa ma

mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda thil snyi zhes pa 'di 'ang tshogasasmon las 'phros bskul ba dbon po mo rgyan bstan 'dzin nas bkra shis dge ba'i skyes du mar bcas te nan tan chen po bskul ngor/ 6kho bo nu ldan 'dusapa rtsal gyisadabyings sna mkha' 'gro'i brda mdzod las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni lung na me drisabagyisapa dge legs 'phel sarba ma lam

rabarte zab lam gsang ba snying khrag las snang gsal pra yi cha lag shel dkar me long bzhugs soXri sgo/ na mo tswa na ḍagini ye zas(1sgoman/ bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis las can skal bzang pho mo la blang dor gnas rnams gsal byed kyis 'phrul snang kun shes bra mo bstan sam yu 'di la spyi don lnga yi bstan dang po grib bsangs bya ba ni lha shing sna tshogs dud pa btang ཿ rin chen phye mar gsur dud btangaḥ sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis kye ma rig gzung 'ardzan gnyis snang grib bag chags 'thas pa'i dri ma kun bsangs sbyangs dag par ma byas na ye shes lha yi zhal ras sgribaḥ 'jig rten lha la mnol rtsog phogaḥ rang bzhin kun nas snyog cing 'thibs las dang nyon mongs 'ching rgya yisaḥ 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i mtshan ma rtsa sgrib byed dug lnga'i sprin tshogs kun shes rab rang bzhin me yis bsregasaḥ ye shes byin ldan chu yis bkrusaX stobs chen drwa ba rlang gis gtoraX dud pa chos dbyings stong par brdalaX me lce bar snang yangs par mnyam ༷ 'dod yon kun khyab

rol rtsed brgyur ye shesalnga yi bsangasadud kyis phyi nang 'byung ba'i dri ma kun dag gsal shel gyi phung por gyuraḥrkye shug sngon g.yu yi bsangs dud kyisaḥ 'byung ba semasadang nam mkha' bsangs sur dkar dngul gyi dud sprin gyis rnam shes khrag dang chu khams bsangs mkhan pa gser gyi bsangs dud kyis nyon yid sha dang sa khamasabasangs gya rta byi ru'i sprin 'khrigasapas yid dang drod me'i khams kun bsangasaḥ 'om bu be+eḍār+ya'i dud kyisaḥ las rlung dbugs dang rlung khams bsangs 'dod yon phung po'aphro ba yis gnyis snang sems gyi dri ma bsangs rang bzhin ma grub stong gsal gyis bag chags gshis kyi dri ma bsangs ma 'dres sa ler gsal ba yi thogs med mkhyen pa'i mngon shes dang mi rmongs blang dor mkhas pa yi shes rab sgog tu shar ba dang bar med rang rig 'od gsal ba'i ye shes chags thogs bral ba dang grubamatha' blo yis gzhal bya kun zil gnon thogs med klong rdol gyi ye shes snang ba rgyas gyur cigaḥ rathagos le sang nge yeḥ pra mo ye yeX zhur zhuraḥ thig thig a dar+shatsakyu

da pa tsar+sā ko ma sal sal phyes phyes swā hāX ces brjod bsang gis dag par byaḥ sa ma yuḥ gnyis pa khrul kyi bkru ba ni 'a bdud rtsi 'khrul bar gas tha a smra ta yi dbang bskur nas lha nyid 'odazhu bdud rtsir bsgyu ཿ kyi d+me rig bag chags 'khor ba'i gribaḥ las nyon lhan skyes sgrib pa rnamasaḥ dag byed gtsang ma chab kyi chus bde ba chen por dag gyur cig kye bdechen g.yu 'brug rma bya dang ru sbal kha nas 'bab pa'i chu dag byed chen po 'ad dag ga'i: rang bzhin khro bo'i rdul 'khrigs pa'i greshasda lhal khrus gsol loX bde chen rol ba'izhal mdangs stonaḥ rdo rje phag mor sku khrus gso la0 wan skyes mi shes rang nal ston nyi 'od 'bar ra/ra sku khyas gsol rmo pa'i dri ma sangs bar mdzodaḥ dbyangs canalha mor sku khrus bag chags 'gapa 2dre byang gyur cigaḥ g.yu yesgopamarasku khrus dmu gab sgrab g.yog rteng bar mdzod gang ba bzang por sku khrus bse 'geng the'u ra 'byung po thulaX snying ju nga btsad po ra sku zus phu mda' sha dargyasachadakun gsol 5bdag rnams la sku khrus thogs med ra tho ba'i sgron me sbor mo bdag yongs la sku

khrus gsal ba'i rde'u nor med phob lha rten rdzas la khrus 'jur 'gags chag ral skyon kun sbyangs dkyil 'khor dal la khrus gsol lo0 ma tshang bshams nyes dri kun bsalaḥ mchod bskang rdzas la khrus rgyu chung phud nyams dri kun bcom mthong ba'i rdzas la khrus gsol loḥ mthong 'grims 'gom yug dri ma sbyangasaḥ 'gug pa'i rdzas la sku khrusagasolaḥ mdze yug mgar ba'i dri bslad basbyangasaḥ bdug pa'i rdzas la khrus thugs dang mi mthun 'dres pa sbyangasaḥ bskrad pa'i rdzas la khrus rno ngar nus pa nyams pa gsoḥ sgrub pa po la khrus gsol loḥ ting 'dzin bying zhing rig pa gcol spyod pa 'chol zhing sha khrag changaḥ bag med spyod 'khrul dag gyur cigaḥsgrub khang 'de la khrus gsol mi gtsang mnol rtsog sang gyur cigaḥ rol mo rnams la khrus snyan la 'khru ba'i sgra ngan bsangasaḥ yo byad rnams la khrus gzhung bzhin ma tshang ral ba bsangasaḥ mdor na snang gsal pra mo la nyes 'gal mi rung dri ma'i tshogasaḥ rnam rtog yid kyi mtshan ma kunaḥ zang thal rol ba chen po yisaḥ bkru zhing byab la sbyang byed naḥ thams cad mi gnas stong
