e dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hiX ces pa sa gnyan chen thang lhar 'bulaḥhū bh+yoḥri rab gling bzhir mnga' dbang bsgyuraḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgog 'dzin ma ༷ rgyal ba'i bka' nyan thatshig canaḥ yul 'khor bsrung dang 'phags skyes bu mig mi bzang dang rnam thos srasaḥdri za gshin rje klu gnod sbyinaX rang rang sde 'khor bye ba 'bumaḥ kun kyang brtse ba'i gnasa'adir gshegs brgyan pa'i dkar gtor skyems phud bzhesaḥ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dngaX sems can yongs la bde skyid spel phyogs bzhi'i mtha' dmag gapo'akhrugs bzlogaX sgrub mchog phrin las rnam bzhi rtsol0 rtags dang mtshan ma bzang por ston0 dngos grub sgrub pa'i bskul ma mdzodaX 'tsho ba sbyor ba'i yon bdag gyis 'galarkyen bzlog pa'i pho nya mdzodaḥ bcol ba'i las mdzod sa ma yāḥ ces pas rgyal pho sde bzhi brdanaḥhū bh+yoḥbade chen ye shes dkyil 'khor nasaX rgyal ba bskyed pa'i ma ma yumaḥ dam tshigagasang ba'i gnyer 'dzin moX bla med he ru'i bstan pa bsrung ma mo spun bdun sprul 'dor bcasaḥ 'dir gshegs skyems gtor mchod pa bzhes gsang sngags bstan pa rin

'o/ po cheḥ dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol der 'dzin thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhingaX bshad sgrub 'dus sde rgyas par mdzod smon log dam sri mtha rdormoje rnamasaḥ ming tsam med par rdul du rlogaḥ tshe sarba ṭak+ki nai e dam bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā nyiḥ ces pas ma bdun dag la 'bulaḥ/ bh+yoḥskyes mchog lha yi sras po dngaḥ lcam moshel dkar gzugs legs maX lha 'khor brgya stong bye ba 'bumaX kun kyang bstan la rnam par gdung ༷ sgrub pa po yi dam la gnas rnal 'byor dbang phyug bu bzhin skyongs thatshig zab mo'i don la gnasaX 'phags pa'i bka' bzhin bod khams skyongs kun kyang 'dir gshegs mchod gtor bzhes bdag gi brin las thog med sgrub zas noralongs spyod char bzhin phobaX tshe sgrub mtha' ru phyin pa dngaX gdul bya 'bangs 'khor las kyis 'brelaX kun kyang 'phags pa'i spyan snga sa mngon par byang chub mchog thob shog oṃ ma hā de wa dz+nyā na de wi sarba sa ma ya e rda ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi ces pa'i lta bu mchod zung brngan (1ཿtha ga mdza la 'brel ba chosaḥ gnam sa gtsang chab phyed kyi bdag

skyes mchog dam can rdo rje legs mched 'khor sum brgya drug bcu poX ma thogs 'dir gshegs rten la bzhugasaḥ dgyes bskyed phyi nang gsang mchod dngaḥ sman gtor rak+ta ja chang skyems dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha khrag gis gsol lo mchod do thugs dam bskangasaX mnga' gsol dbu 'phangs bstod par bgyiḥ khyed la phrin las bcol ba ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa nub med bsrungaX der 'dzin bu slob sku tshe bsrengasaḥ bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang rgyasaX sgrub pa po la mthun rkyen stsolaX dam sri mtha' dmag rdul du rlogaX rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las sgrub ma g.yel ma 'khyang sa ma yāḥ ma badz+ra sa rdu sa ma ya rat+na e rda bā ling ta abri ta rak+ta khā hiḥ ces pas dam can skyes bu mchod de nas phrin las bcol ba naḥ hū spyo rgyal ba'i rgyal sras rig 'dzin gyisaḥ bka' bsgos dam bzhag tha tshig canaX ma lus 'khor bcas 'dir gshegs laX brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ yang pa'i rgyal khams bde bas 'tshoḥ nad mug mtshon 'khrugs rgud pa sol phyogs las rnam rgyal ru mtshon phyoraḥ 'jigs tshogs ming gi lhag mar gyuraḥ 'byor drug

sgo nyams rtogs mkha' ltar rgyasaḥ khams gsum srid gsum mos bzhi dbangaX phan dang bde ba'i dge mtshan bskyedaX lo legs 'bru 'phel rtsi bcud spel (tā bstan spyi dang rdo rje thegaX rmad byud 'bras bu a ti'i bcudaX mi nub phyogs bcur dar rgyas zhing ཿ bstan pa 'dzin pa'i skyes bu rnamasaḥ thugs mthun khrims gtsang dam tshig dgaX gang 'dul mdzad pa mthar phyin nasaX don gnyis lhun gyis grub gyur cig0 bstan la rgol zhing 'gro la 'tshe smon log dam sri bdud kyi rigasaḥ dgra bgegs 'byung po ma lus pa mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzodaX sha khrag don snying rngams zas kyis bco la ba'i las rnams g.yel med sgrubaX ma 'da' badz+ra sa ma yāḥ ces brjod gtor skyems gtsangasar gshegs slar yang bzod gsol bshags pa ni hoḥ bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho dgongasaḥ bdag rmongs blo yi mi dge'i lasaḥ gang bsags gnong zhing 'gyod pas bshagasaX 'khrulab dag sangs bzod par bzhes ya ge brgya bas bshags sbyangs bya rten la bzhugs su gsol teḥsnyen dharma pa la sa sarba ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan ces brjod me tog 'thor ba dang rten 'brel snyang pos rab tu gnas

slar yang shes brjod bya ba niḥ hūḥ byin rlabs mkha' la thugs rje'i nyi ma sharaḥ brgyud ldan rig 'dzin rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog dngos grub sprin 'khrigs sgrub 'bras sbrang char 'bebasaḥ yi dam rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bkra shis shog 'dod 'byung dpag bsam ljon 'bras dus su smin dbyings gsum ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i sgrub 'bras dus smin brin las glog ltar 'khyug bstan bsrungs dam can rgya mtsho'i dbul phongs rgud sel 'dod 'byung gaṅga'i rgyun nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi chos mthun bsam 'grub dri bral nyams rtogs rgyasaX tshe gcig rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i bkra shis regag zhes dang mtha' brgyan shis brjod bya gnad kyis phran la gegs med 'grub srung ma lus dang grib ltar 'grogs ཿ phya nang bar chad g.yul las rgyal don gnyis gegs med 'grub par gyur the tshom med do rdo rje'i bka' byin rlabs zab pa'i bcud chen 'diḥ thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog skal med lag tu ma shor cigaḥ sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ brda thamaḥ (9)cesapa 'ad yang bla ma rig grol rgya mtshos nan tan du bskul ngor sprang spyon nu ldan pas mdo khams brag lha mgon po' gnas mdun nas spel ba dge legs 'phelaḥ sarba ma leḥ

sna dag snang ye shes rol ba lasathugs rje chen po 'gro ba rnam 'dren gyiḥtshogs mchod phan bde 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs soḥ— pa —— na mo ār+ya lo ka sha ra ye sgorgagathagab/smo rab khrums rgyal ba thams cad kyas phrin las 'gro 'dul mkhyen brtse'i phyir 'gro ba rnam 'dren spyan ras gzigs bde pho 'khor lo'i rgyan du rol ma 'o sa 'gro la phan pa'i sman zab pa phul phyin gdams pa ni thugs rje chen po 'a zab sgrub dang tshos mchod phan bde'i nga gnas bstan sa ma yuḥde yang bza' bca' btung ba' rigs sha khrag 'dod yon bye bragakun bsags la ran pho snod nang 4 dum gcig ka pā la tu bskyil dang po byin brlabs bya ba niḥ āXchos dbyings dang mnyam snod nang duXbaza' bca' btung bar 'os pa'i rigasaḥ'abru gsum nus pas sbyang spel bsgyuraḥ'adzad med kun bzang rol bar gyuraXm ā hūṃ ha ho trīḥlan gsum gnyis pa spyan 'dren bya ba ni nyu trīḥlho phyogs ri bo gru 'dzin nas 'phags mchog smran ras gzigs dbang la 'gro 'dul 'khor tshogs dang bcas nas 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lor gshegs gnas mchog 'di la byin chen phob sgrub mchog rnams

la dbang bzhi bskuraḥ bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad solaX mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol o ār+ya lo ke shā ra ya sarba sa ma ya dza dzaḥ gsum pa tshogs phud 'bul ba niḥ hū dze+e bza' btung longasaspyod 'dod rgu'i gteraX sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rdzas ye shes 'od zer 'phro ba 'di 'phags mchog thugs rje'i lha la 'bulaX oṃ ma hā ga ṇa byu dza khā hiḥ bzhi ba bshags sbyangs ram pa ni ho dpang gyur lha dang srung ma dgongs bdag rmongs 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur teḥ rtsa ba yan lag dam nyams paḥ tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshagasaḥ badz+ra sa ma shusnye āḥ lnga ba bsgral las bya ba niḥ hū sto snying rje chen tho'i ngang nyid lasaḥ gdug pa 'dul mdzad he ru gaḥ dbang gi rgyal po'i skur bzhengs nas:gdug can bsgral ba'i las mdzod cigaḥ sarba dra ༅ mā ra ya phaṭaḥ drug pa bstab 'bul bya ba naḥ hūṃḥ chos nyid mnyam pa'i zhal bum duḥ log rtog bsgral ba'i phung khams bstabasaX rol ba chen por 'ub chub nasaX 'khrul med rgyal ba'i sras gyur cigaḥ sa sarba sha tru dz+wa la ram̐ ram̐ khā hiḥ bdun pa lhag ma 'bul ba na theḥ lhag la dbang ba'i pho nya rnams 'dir

sgo dri gshegs bka' yi pham phab bzhesaḥ gsang sngags bstan pa bsrung ba dngaḥ sgrub pa po yi phrin las stsolaX oṃ sarba gikhruṭa bha ling ta kha kha khā hi kha hiX brgyad pa garted ma bskul ba ni nyu bh+yoX spros bral bde ba chen po nas stong nyid snying rje'i rang mdangs garaX gdug pa 'dul ba'i dpal du bzhengasaḥ mngon spyod las kun thogs med sgrubasaX snyigs ma'i ru 'dzing bzlog pa dang 'jig rten bde skyid nyi ma sbor rgyal bstan nub pa mi mnga' bar phyogs las rnam rgyal phrin las mdzod ma 'da' badz+ra sa ma yuḥces brjod gtor skyems gtsa sar gshegs dgu ba lo mdo gtong ba niḥ sa bh+yoX sngon tsho bar dang tha ma laḥ spyi dpal pad 'byung rig 'dzin gyi spyan sngar khas bla sa mna' bor ba'i dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang las mdzad bco brgyad spu gri gsumaḥ phyi nang gsang ba mchog sprul gyi sde brgyad dregs pa rgya mtsho' tshogasaX sngon gyi tha tshig ji bzhin duḥ 'dod yon mchod gtor 'di bzhes laḥ rnal 'byor phyi nang nyer 'tshe bzlog bstan pa 'i sel byed phung sri sgrol0 dus kyi ru 'dzing ngan pa gzhomasaX zab gas mchog gi bstan pa spelaX

rtag ges sgro 'dogs lta log bsnubs 'jig rten bde skyid ldan pa dang dam pa chos kyis 'tsho bzhin du bde nas bde bar byang chub mdzodaḥ khyad par 'od gsal thig le'i klongaX rang rig ston pa pad 'byung gisaX gnyug ma gshis kyi pha phog nyid rig 'dzin nus ldan rdo rje la sred len bral ba'i brda thabs kyisaḥ gnyis med rol bar mnga' gsol tshe che ba'i dpal bskyed king brgyad dang dbyings kyi ma drug la sogs pas 'khrul 'khor gshis grol tha tshig bzhinaḥ brngan pa'i gtor skyems 'di bzhes la las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzodaX r+sā pa bstan skyo brngan pa niḥ / hrīḥ lugs 'byung rten 'brel 'khor ba'i chos kun rdzob 'khrul ba dbyings rol ba'i grol dang 'khrul ba'i sa 'dzin zhingaX nyon 'khrul rmongs pa'i dam sri sgrol ldog med a tis bstan pa spel tha tshig la gnas zab gsang skyongs ma mo bcu gnyis 'di gshegs la brngan pa'i mchod gtor dgyes bzhes te srid pa'i rtsa ba ru bzlog nasaḥ 'khrul ba bzhi la sangs bar mdzodaX oṃ ma ma hring hrīng bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi0 bcu gcig rta bro brdung ba niḥ hū bh+yoḥ rab

shā 'jigs rngams brjid e yi klongaḥ ma rig nyon 'khrul dam sri brubaḥ mnan no sku dang ye shes rgyaḥ nam yang 'phar sdang med pa rtsa byang chub chen sor sangs rgyadro shogaḥ mi nub snying po dar gyur cigaḥ sa āḥhūṃ swāhā stum bha ya nanaḥ mā ra ya nan nanaḥ r+sā gnyis dngos grub blangs pa ni nyu hrīḥdribral thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor nas mi gnas ye shes rdo rje'i dbang gsang ba gsum gyi dngos grub mchogaḥ bde stong 'gyur med sirnyi stam rtsa sngags mthar ka ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba garma sirnyi pha la hūṃ ā bcu gsum bshag pa bya ba na hoX skyabs mchog 'gro mgon thugs rje canaḥ spyan ras gzigs dbang brtse bas dgongasaḥ bdag rmongs ma rig mi dge'i las ci bgyis gnong 'gyod drag posabashags badz+ra sa ma ya snyi shud+dhi a bcu bzhi bsngo ba smon lam niḥhoX 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta nas bsags dang bsags gyur bsags pa yi dge rtsa 'dzadar gsum dag par bsngoḥ phyam gcig 'phags pa'i sa thob shog lan gsum bco lnga rtag chad mtha' bsal niḥ āḥ snang cha thabs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams rdo rje btsun mo'i mkha' la bsdu slar yang thugs rje'i ye shes

rtsalaX lha snang rgyu ma'i spyod lam bya'oḥ pāṭa pāṭaX bcu drug bkra shis bya ba niḥ na moḥ chos dbyings ka dag nam mkha' la lhun grub sku gsum nyi zla rgyasaḥ gdul bya gnyis rtog mun pa selaḥ rang byung ye shes bkra shis shogaḥ mi 'gyur gangs ri'i lhun po las 'gags med thugs rje'i sbrang char g.yoḥ gdul bya'i pad tshal rab rgyas pa'i spyan ras gzigs kyibakra shis re gaX 'gro ba gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad pa rmad byung dus smin nas: khams gsum 'khor ba sku gsum duḥ mngon par byang chub bkra shis 31ga0 ces brjod me tog salam bkram rol mo sna tshogs sgra sgrog zhing dga' ston mtha' rgyal bsngo smon bya gnad des tshogasachen gnyis rdzogs nas dam pa sku gnyis thob par 'gyuraḥ phan bde'i lo 'bras dus su sminaḥ shan tu zab pa thugs bcud skor rin chen phra yig gnyis pa can bcu phrag gsum gyis rgya ldan pa smar gyi dharma blo gros rgyalaḥ rgyal ba byang chub dbang skal che las smon gyis bskul bidu ya da ཿ mdzod ldan ku mud rgya mtsho zungs ཿ rten 'brel mchog gi rtsa bar zungs ma grags dkar mo byang ma snyan rgyang grags phul du de yi 'bud rig ldan thugs kyi sras po zhe rdo rje'i ming la surlas brgyan sngags rig grub pa'i dpa 'a bo yis bgo skal dam pa e ma nyo sa ma yuḥ rgya rgya rgya gu rgyaḥ (3)ces pa

——13 'di 'ang pho rog rdo rje'i 'gros mgyogs mang ba'i mnga' 'og du phyogs kyi gangs seng dkar mo dus slebs kyis bdud rtsi'i zil 'bras 'bebs kyang tshong ma ring tshe phyogs kyi las ldan cha shas la rnam par sad pa'i nang tshan gyi sde bye ba las nang don cu zad myong ba thob pa yi bla ma dam pa lha rje rig grol ro mdo med sprang spyon rgad po kun nyi yi dpal ldan brag lha mgon pa 'i gnas mdun nas0 rnam bar spel ba 'gro khams dong sprugs regagaḥ sarba maṅga lamaḥ

da rdo dag snang yeshes rol ba las thugs rje chen po 'gro ba rnam 'dren gyi dgyes bskang bsod nams mtha' yas bzhugs soḥ——3 na ma ār+ya lo ki shā ra ye shā 5rtsa spyod gnajam byams dang brtse ba'i gter mnga' zhing 'gro ba 'khor ba'i 'dam las skyobs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang la gusapa'abatud de snyi nas 'dud ma 'ongs las ldan pho mo yis tshogs gnyas gegs med ོgas pa' phyir ga ṇa tsakra'i 'bul thabs kyas cha lag dgyes bskang zab mo bstanaḥsam yuḥphyi mchod dngosa'adzan dag par 'bul nangamachod ston mongs dag par stobs gsang mchod byang sems dag pa'i bskang gnyisamed bde chen rol par 'bulaḥzhes pa bzhin du legs par 'bul bskang sabyin brlabs legs par bya de nas snyan pa'i dbyangs bcas te hūṃ hūṃ shāḥka dag spros bral mngon byang chubaḥdagongs brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang ma 'dres mngon gzigs ting 'dzin thobaḥbarda rgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang bka' gter zab pa'i don kun 'byedaḥsnyan rgyad bla ma'i phul byin ranyag ma'i ba sgo bkrol tshig brgyad bla ma'i smon lam las 'phro 'gro la ngoms brgyad ldan bla ma'i thugs

dam dri med pad+ma rā ga'i mdangasaḥ rnam ba mtha' yas thugs dam bskangasaḥ rnam dag byang chub sems kyi mdangs0 nam mkha' rgyal po'i brdzus skyes sprul sku 'gro ba'i mgon0 pad+ma ka ra'i ma rig mun sel shes rab gzugasaḥ 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi stong nyid snying rje'i dpal mdangs mnga'aX gsung ba 'dus kyis mthu stobs chen pos gdug pa 'dulaX phyag na rdo rje'i sku mchog 'gyur ba mi mnga' baḥ 'jam dpal sku yi gsung mchog 'gags pa med pa'i garaḥ pad+ma gsung gi thugs mchog g.yo ba med pa'i slongaX yang dag thugs kyi yon tan stobs rdzogs bdud rtsi sman che mchog lha tshogs phrin las drag pos 'gro ba 'dul bdud 'dul phur ba'i dmod sbyor sbod gtong tshar gcod pa'iḥ bla med he ru'i brgyud ldan rig 'dzin kun gyis gtsoḥrdo rje chos kyi thugs dam bskang gdon dang bgegs tshogs dran pas 'dul dregs pa kun 'dul ma rung 'byung po rdul brlag pa'iX stobs ldan lha tshogs bka' nyan phrin las sgrub pa'i grogasaX dam can rgya mtsho'i theg tshogs rgya mtsho'i bcud rdzogs pa 'dus pa mdo yi thugs byin

'o/ char 'bebs dbang bskur rgyal po rje: dngos grub sprin gtibs yi dam lhag pa'i lhaḥ bde stong char 'bebs dbyings gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rtsargesgormi rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin la bstodaḥ bstod 'os phyag 'os dus gsum sangs rgyas laḥ rdul rted lus sprul khyed shes dad phyag bcasaḥ dam tshig phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan pasabastodaX rnam kun thugs rjes ma dor rjes bzung 'tshalaX nyer spyod kya ma 'a dbul ni kyiḥ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po thabs mkhas pasaḥ 'gro ba'i rmongs mun rab rib bsal bltaraḥ de bzhin bdag gis bde bshegs spyan dbye naḥ 'gro ba 'dren pa'i gzigs pa nub med stsolaḥ tshe tsakyu tsakyu sa marnya tsakyu bhi shwa dha ni swāhāḥ tshe ru pā shabha gadhe ra sa spasne.āḥ(ཿ spyan sogs dab po lnga 'gro ba'i don du dbye ba la 'dod yon lngas mchod pa'oḥ sngags kyi ma 'a dbul ni rab tu gnas byashā rten rnams kyi thugs gar zla ba la gnas pa'i sngags phreng 'khe raba'i 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rten so so'i rnam par byon nas de dag la bzhugs par gyuraḥ sku rten la dmags te oṃ hūṃ hrī d+ngha khaṃ badz+ra bha wa ṭi dha tiṣ+ṭha bhi

khaṃ swāhāḥ gsung rten la dmigs te ye dharma'i sngags dang thugs rten la dmigs teḥ skyed sarba bīduswāhāḥ thams cad rab tu gnas phyir skyes ༄ sra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhāḥ thams cad spel mar byas la ci rigs brjodamathar phun sum tshogs pa sogs sho lo ka gsum gyis shes pa brjod me tog 'thor lhag chad kha skong phyir yig brgya lan gsum bzlas mthar mchod pa naḥ ho ༷ me tog bdug ༷ sa mar me dri zhal rol lha rdzas las grub phyi nang gsang mchod sprinaḥ dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod pa'i tshogs: bder gshegs dngos po rten gyi dkyil 'khor mchodaḥ badz+ra byu dza sarba sa ma ya ho hoḥ rab snyan dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtshor bcas rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs yon phrin las la rnam pa kun tu dad mos tshad med pas phyag 'tshal mchod cing bstod pa 'bul bar bgyi gsol gdab niḥ yo 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan gcig tuḥ 'dor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang0 nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dngaḥ chos rnams legs par stsal du gsolaḥ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dbo ngas su gsolaḥ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i
